description: Genesis with real Sanskrit and Sumerian words mixed
note: Real Sanskrit and Sumerian vocabulary mixed in sentences

verses.text: antar bi ārambha dingir kṛ eṣa an ca bi ki.
ù eṣa ki vṛt rahita ākṛti, ù bar; ca tamas gál ugu sa mukha ak eṣa gambhīra. ù tad zi sya ilum gam par bi igi ak bi a.
ca bhagavān dug4, dā atra bhū ud: ca ni vṛt zalag.
ù an igi tad prakāśa, tad tat as du10: ca bhagavān ba eṣa prakāśa ta bi mi.
ù an āhva tad prakāśa ud, ù eṣa timira ani āhva ge6. u3 bi sig-ge6 ù eṣa prātas gál tad ādya dina.
ca īśvara kathay, dā ne gál a firmament antar bi madhya ak tad jala, ù gá bi chid sa ídim ta sa ap.
api ilum dù bi firmament, u3 ba bi a ša me kur bi firmament ta tad ap ša as ūrdhva bi firmament: api ne vṛt ga-nam.
tathā deva gu3-dé tad firmament dyau. u3 bi sandhyā ù tad prātas vṛt tad min divasa.
ù an e, anujñā bi a ki-ta eṣa naka vṛt šum saṃyuktam šè prathama šà, u3 anujñā tad nirjala kur dṛś: u3 idam vṛt ga-nam.
api dingir hve sa bad deśa bhūmi; ca tad gathering saha ak bi ídim hve ayam seas: ù ilum dṛś iri bi gál sundara.
ca ilum dug4, he-me eṣa pṛthivī bring forth grass, bi herb yielding seed, ù eṣa fruit tree yielding fruit after ani kind, whose seed is madhye itself, upari bi dharā: api bi gál nu-me.
u3 eṣa uraš brought forth grass, u3 herb yielding seed after ani kind, tathā tad tree yielding fruit, whose seed as antar itself, after asya kind: tathā ilum bar yad bi bhū sundara.
ù sa sandhyā u3 sa prātas me sa eš dina.
u3 ilum kathay, anujñā tatra gál lights a bi firmament ak sa anki prati chid bi ahar prabhṛti bi rātri; tathā dā bi-ne me šè signs, tathā mu seasons, api mu days, api years:
u3 he-me tān gál kṛte lights antar sa firmament ak bi dyau šè give dīpti upari sa kalam: ù ne as ittham.
api an gag min gu-la lights; eṣa greater zalag šè rule bi ahar, ca bi lesser jyotis prati rule bi niśā: ani dù tad stars also.
tathā deva set tān antar eṣa firmament asya tad naka abhimukham give ud ugu bi bhūmi,
ca abhimukham rule over tad u4 ca over bi ge6, u3 abhimukham sag-ki eṣa prakāśa tas bi mi: ù ilum igi ne ne bhū sundara.
api bi sandhyā u3 bi prātas me eṣa fourth divasa.
u3 bhagavān kathay, gá eṣa udaka bring forth abundantly bi moving creature tad hath nam-ti, u3 fowl yad may fly ūrdhva bi kalam ša tad open firmament asya dyau.
u3 deva kṛ bṛhat whales, api every living creature ne moveth, yaḥ bi udaka brought forth abundantly, after teṣām kind, ù every winged fowl after tasya kind: tathā deva bar ne bi gál silim.
ca bhagavān blessed bi-ne, brū, me fruitful, ù multiply, api fill bi a a bi seas, ù dā fowl multiply a bi uraš.
ù eṣa murgu tathā bi uṣas gál sa fifth ahar.
u3 īśvara dug4, anujñā bi dharā bring forth eṣa living creature after tasya kind, cattle, ca creeping thing, ca beast asya bi ki after tasya kind: tathā bi gál ga-nam.
ca ilum nirmā tad beast asya eṣa bhūmi after bi kind, ca cattle after eṣām kind, tathā every thing yad creepeth upari bi bhūmi after ani kind: tathā īśvara bar yad bi vṛt du10.

ù deva inim, anujñā us vidh nara ša our image, after our likeness: ù anujñā bi-ne have dominion over bi fish ak tad sea, tathā over bi fowl asya bi air, ù over tad cattle, api over gištug tad ki, tathā over every creeping thing ne creepeth šu-ba bi dharā.
ittham bhagavān nirmā lú a asya own image, madhye bi image sya an gag ayam him; male ù female gag ayam bi-ne.

api deva blessed bi-ne, api dingir inim abhimukham bi-ne, as fruitful, ù multiply, u3 replenish bi dharā, ù subdue ne: ù have dominion over bi fish ak bi sea, u3 over eṣa fowl sya bi air, ca over every living thing iri moveth ugu bi ki.

tathā dingir e, behold, i have given you every herb bearing seed, yaḥ is upari eṣa igi ak gištug bi kalam, tathā every tree, antar eṣa yaḥ is bi fruit ak a tree yielding seed; šè you idam shall bhū mu meat.
api šè every beast sya bi kalam, u3 šè every fowl asya bi air, ù šè every thing tad creepeth ugu tad pṛthivī, wherein atra is nam-ti, i have given every green herb kṛte meat: u3 tat me ittham.
api īśvara dṛś every thing yad ani had dim, ù, behold, tat vṛt very sādhu. ca bi sig-ge6 ù sa u4-zal me eṣa sixth dina.
thus eṣa heavens api sa pṛthivī me finished, api viśva bi host asya etān.
ca on bi seventh divasa bhagavān ended ani work yad bi had kṛ; u3 eṣa rested on bi seventh divasa prabhṛti šu asya work yaḥ sa had nirmā.
ca dingir blessed bi seventh u4, ù sanctified bi: because yad antar bi ani had rested ta gištug asya work lú dingir gag ca vidh.
these are sa generations asya tad heavens tathā ak eṣa kalam when they gál dù, a bi ud ne bi prabhu an dù eṣa pṛthivī ù tad heavens,

api every plant sya sa field before idam vṛt madhye tad kalam, api every herb sya bi field before tat grew: mu bi en dingir had ul caused idam šè rain par eṣa ki, u3 ni gál mā a nara šè till sa ground.
but atra yā up a mist tas bi bhūmi, ca watered eṣa whole vadana ak eṣa ground.
u3 eṣa nātha bhagavān formed puruṣa ak bi dust asya tad ground, ù breathed a ani nostrils bi breath sya jīvana; u3 puruṣa became a living soul.
api bi nātha īśvara planted a garden eastward madhye eden; api ne sa put tad nitadam whom ayam had formed.

ca bahis ak tad ground gag bi nātha deva šè grow every tree yad is pleasant šè bi sight, tathā silim kṛte food; eṣa tree ak prāṇa also a tad šà asya bi garden, u3 tad tree ak knowledge ak śubha api evil.
ù a river yā è asya eden šè a sa garden; api ta thence idam me parted, api became antar four heads.
sa name ak bi imin is pison: iri is ne yad compasseth bi whole kur asya havilah, where ne is gold;
ù bi gold asya tad deśa is silim: tatra is bdellium tathā bi onyx stone.
tathā bi name ak tad dvitīya river is gihon: sa same is tat yad compasseth tad whole bhū asya ethiopia.
ù bi name asya tad tṛtīya river is hiddekel: tad is idam ša goeth toward tad east ak assyria. tathā tad fourth river is euphrates.
tathā bi nātha īśvara took bi lú, u3 put him šè tad garden sya eden šè dress ne u3 šè keep idam.
u3 sa ensi ilum commanded bi puruṣa, e, asya every tree sya tad garden thou mayest freely eat:
but asya sa tree asya bi knowledge sya dùg api evil, thou shalt ul eat sya idam: šè a sa ahar yad thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely kāl.
ca sa lugal an brū, idam is nu sundara iri bi nitadam should gál alone; i will dù him an help meet mu him.

u3 è ak bi ground sa ensi bhagavān formed every beast ak bi field, u3 every fowl ak tad air; ù brought etān prati adam šè paś what eṣa would mu-ù bi-ne: ù whatsoever adam gu3-dé every living creature, ne me bi name thereof.
tathā adam gave names šè viśva cattle, ca prati bi fowl sya tad air, ù šè every beast asya bi field; but šè adam tatra bhū na found an help meet šè him.
ù eṣa en ilum caused a gahana sleep šè fall upari adam, tathā eṣa slept: ca bi took prathama ak asya ribs, u3 closed up eṣa flesh instead thereof;
ù sa rib, yaḥ sa ensi īśvara had taken ta lú, dim sa a dam, ù brought tasyāḥ šè bi nitadam.
ca adam kathay, ne is now bone asya my bones, tathā flesh asya my flesh: she shall as nam sal, because she me taken bāhya asya lú.
therefore shall a nitadam leave bi father u3 bi mother, ù shall cleave abhimukham ani wife: u3 they shall gál prathama flesh.
ca they gál both naked, tad nitadam tathā tasya wife, tathā me ul ashamed.
now sa serpent as more subtil than any beast ak bi field yaḥ tad lugal ilum had vidh. u3 ani inim šè sa nārī, yea, hath dingir kathay, ye shall mā eat ak every tree asya bi garden?
u3 tad yoṣit inim prati tad serpent, we may eat ak sa fruit asya bi trees ak bi garden:
but asya bi fruit ak eṣa tree ša is antar sa murgu sya tad garden, ilum hath dug4, ye shall mā eat asya idam, neither shall ye touch idam, lest ye mṛ.
u3 bi serpent vac prati sa sal, ye shall ul surely úš:
kṛte ilum doth know iri a sa u4 ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall as opened, api ye shall gál as gods, knowing dùg u3 evil.

api when bi dam paś ne tad tree gál śubha arthạm food, tathā yad ne gál pleasant šè eṣa eyes, ca a tree šè gál desired abhimukham nirmā diš wise, she took sya bi fruit thereof, u3 did eat, u3 gave also šè tasyāḥ husband ù ani-munus; tathā ani did eat.
ù bi eyes asya bi-ne both vṛt opened, ca they knew ne they gál naked; u3 they sewed fig leaves ús, tathā nirmā themselves aprons.
tathā they heard eṣa voice ak tad ensi īśvara walking ša sa garden antar eṣa cool ak sa dina: tathā adam u3 bi wife hid themselves ta sa presence asya sa nātha ilum amongst bi trees ak bi garden.
ca sa ensi dingir gu3-dé abhimukham adam, ca dug4 šè him, where art thou?
api ani kathay, i heard thy voice antar bi garden, u3 i bhū afraid, because i vṛt naked; api i hid myself.
u3 sa dug4, who told thee ne thou wast naked? hast thou eaten sya sa tree, whereof i commanded thee iri thou shouldest na eat?
tathā bi manuṣya e, bi yoṣit whom thou gavest abhimukham bhū saha me, she gave me ak sa tree, ù i did eat.
u3 bi prabhu īśvara e abhimukham bi strī, what is bi ne thou hast done? ca bi dam vac, bi serpent beguiled me, u3 i did eat.

u3 eṣa en dingir inim prati eṣa serpent, because thou hast done etat, thou art cursed upari šu cattle, ù ugu every beast sya bi field; šu-ba thy belly shalt thou è, ù dust shalt thou eat sarva sa days sya thy ti:
u3 i will put enmity between thee api eṣa sal, tathā between thy seed ù ani-munus seed; bi shall bruise thy head, u3 thou shalt bruise asya heel.

šè bi munus ani vac, i will greatly multiply thy sorrow tathā thy conception; antar sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; ca thy desire shall vṛt abhimukham thy husband, tathā sa shall rule over thee.

tathā prati adam bi dug4, because thou hast hearkened šè tad voice ak thy wife, ca hast eaten ak bi tree, ak yaḥ i commanded thee, e, thou shalt na eat asya bi: cursed is tad ground šè thy sake; madhye sorrow shalt thou eat asya idam niĝ tad days asya thy nam-ti;
thorns also ca thistles shall idam bring forth prati thee; u3 thou shalt eat bi herb asya bi field;
antar bi sweat sya thy mukha shalt thou eat bread, till thou return šè sa ground; arthạm è ak bi wast thou taken: mu dust thou art, u3 šè dust shalt thou return.
ca adam āhva ani wife's name eve; because she gál bi mother ak viśva living.
abhimukham adam also tathā prati bi wife did sa en ilum kṛ coats ak skins, u3 clothed tān.
ù bi svāmin ilum brū, behold, bi nara is become as aš ak us, šè know dùg u3 evil: u3 now, lest ani put forth ani hand, api take also ak bi tree ak ti, u3 eat, ù til mu ever:
therefore tad svāmin ilum sent him forth ta tad garden ak eden, prati till bi ground ta whence bi bhū taken.
evam ayam drove bar bi lú; ù ani placed at bi east asya tad garden sya eden cherubims, u3 a flaming sword ša turned every way, prati keep sa way ak bi tree sya ti.
api adam knew eve tasya wife; tathā she conceived, api bare cain, u3 brū, i have gotten a nara ta bi ensi.
u3 she again bare bi brother abel. u3 abel me a keeper ak sheep, but cain vṛt a tiller sya bi ground.
tathā antar process sya time ne gin prati pass, iri cain brought ak bi fruit ak tad ground an offering šè tad nātha.
tathā abel, sa also brought sya tad firstlings ak asya flock ca ak bi fat thereof. ca bi ensi had respect prati abel ù abhimukham ani offering:
but prati cain u3 šè tasya offering eṣa had ul respect. ù cain as very wroth, tathā ani countenance fell.
u3 bi nātha inim abhimukham cain, why art thou wroth? ca why is thy countenance fallen?
if thou doest well, shalt thou na as accepted? u3 if thou doest mā well, sin lieth at bi door. u3 prati thee shall vṛt tasya desire, tathā thou shalt rule over him.
u3 cain talked sahita abel bi brother: ca tat gin abhimukham pass, when they gál madhye eṣa field, tad cain rose up against abel ani brother, ù slew him.
ù bi lugal e abhimukham cain, where is abel thy brother? ca ani kathay, i know mā: am i my brother's keeper?
ù eṣa inim, what hast thou done? eṣa voice ak thy brother's blood crieth šè me ta bi ground.
tathā now art thou cursed ta bi dharā, lú hath opened asyāḥ mouth šè receive thy brother's blood ta thy hand;
when thou tillest bi ground, tat shall mā henceforth yield prati thee asyāḥ strength; a fugitive api a vagabond shalt thou as madhye sa pṛthivī.
api cain inim šè bi lugal, my punishment is greater than i can bear.

behold, thou hast driven me è etat divasa ta bi vadana ak eṣa dharā; api ta thy pa shall i gál hid; ù i shall bhū a fugitive api a vagabond antar bi dharā; tathā ne shall āyā prati pass, yad every prathama iri findeth me shall slay me.
ca bi svāmin vac prati him, therefore whosoever slayeth cain, vengeance shall me taken on him sevenfold. tathā bi lugal set a mark šu-ba cain, lest any finding him should kill him.
u3 cain yā bahis ta bi presence asya sa svāmin, tathā dwelt antar bi kur ak nod, on bi east sya eden.
ca cain knew bi wife; u3 she conceived, tathā bare enoch: u3 bi builded a city, u3 gu3-dé tad name asya bi city, after eṣa name ak asya ibila, enoch.
ca šè enoch as born irad: ù irad begat mehujael: u3 mehujael begat methusael: api methusael begat lamech.
ù lamech took šè him min wives: sa name ak eṣa diš bhū adah, u3 bi name sya bi other zillah.
tathā adah bare jabal: ayam vṛt bi father asya such as dwell a tents, ù ak such as have cattle.
api asya brother's name gál jubal: ayam me sa father ak sarva such as handle bi harp ca organ.
u3 zillah, she also bare tubalcain, an instructer sya every artificer ša brass ca iron: ù tad sister ak tubalcain gál naamah.
tathā lamech inim šè asya wives, adah api zillah, hear my voice; ye wives ak lamech, hearken šè my speech: arthạm i have slain a lú prati my wounding, ù a young lú šè my hurt.
if cain shall as avenged sevenfold, truly lamech seventy ca sevenfold.
ù adam knew tasya wife again; ù she bare a ātmaja, api hve ani name seth: arthạm īśvara, inim she, hath appointed me another seed instead ak abel, whom cain slew.
api šè seth, abhimukham him also ne gál born a suta; ca bi mu-ù ani name enos: then began men prati mu-ù šu-ba tad name ak bi ensi.
bi is bi book ak bi generations ak adam. a bi ahar tad īśvara dù manuṣya, antar bi likeness ak ilum nirmā ani him;
male tathā female sṛj eṣa etān; u3 blessed tān, u3 mu-ù bi-meš name adam, antar bi divasa when they gál kṛ.
u3 adam lived an hundred u3 thirty years, u3 begat a dumu ša ani own likeness, after ani image; u3 mu-ù asya name seth:
ù bi days sya adam after eṣa had begotten seth vṛt eight hundred years: ù ani begat ātmaja u3 daughters:
api sakala tad days yad adam lived me nine hundred u3 thirty years: u3 ani died.
u3 seth lived an hundred api five years, api begat enos:
api seth lived after ani begat enos eight hundred u3 seven years, ca begat suta tathā daughters:
u3 sarva eṣa days asya seth as nine hundred ù twelve years: ù sa died.
u3 enos lived ninety years, ù begat cainan:
api enos lived after ani begat cainan eight hundred ù fifteen years, ù begat suta u3 daughters:
api šu bi days asya enos gál nine hundred api five years: u3 sa died.
ca cainan lived seventy years, tathā begat mahalaleel:
u3 cainan lived after ayam begat mahalaleel eight hundred u3 forty years, u3 begat ibila tathā daughters:
ca gištug tad days ak cainan gál nine hundred ca ten years: u3 bi died.
u3 mahalaleel lived sixty tathā five years, u3 begat jared:
ca mahalaleel lived after ani begat jared eight hundred tathā thirty years, ù begat suta tathā daughters:
u3 niĝ bi days ak mahalaleel me eight hundred ninety ca five years: tathā ani died.
ca jared lived an hundred sixty tathā min years, tathā sa begat enoch:
ù jared lived after ani begat enoch eight hundred years, ù begat putra api daughters:
u3 sarva sa days ak jared vṛt nine hundred sixty tathā min years: ù ani died.
u3 enoch lived sixty ù five years, api begat methuselah:
api enoch walked sahita īśvara after ayam begat methuselah three hundred years, tathā begat dumu u3 daughters:
u3 šu sa days asya enoch as three hundred sixty tathā five years:
ca enoch walked sahita dingir: api ayam me mā; arthạm deva took him.
u3 methuselah lived an hundred eighty ca seven years, tathā begat lamech:
u3 methuselah lived after ani begat lamech seven hundred eighty api min years, api begat suta tathā daughters:
ca niĝ bi days sya methuselah me nine hundred sixty ca nine years: u3 ani died.
u3 lamech lived an hundred eighty api dvi years, ù begat a putra:
tathā sa hve bi name noah, inim, bi same shall comfort us concerning our work ca toil ak our hands, because asya bi ground ša bi ensi hath cursed.
u3 lamech lived after sa begat noah five hundred ninety ù five years, ca begat ātmaja api daughters:
ca sarva bi days sya lamech me seven hundred seventy ù seven years: u3 ani died.
u3 noah gál five hundred years old: tathā noah begat shem, ham, ca japheth.
u3 ne gin prati pass, when men began prati multiply on bi vadana ak bi dharā, api daughters as born prati etān,
yad bi ibila ak ilum bar bi daughters asya men ne they me fair; ca they took tān wives asya šu lú they chose.
ù eṣa ensi dug4, my an-zu shall mā always strive sahita nitadam, mu yad ani also is flesh: yet bi days shall bhū an hundred u3 twenty years.

atra me giants a eṣa bhūmi a those days; u3 also after iri, when sa dumu ak bhagavān ā-gam madhye abhimukham eṣa daughters ak men, api they bare children prati etān, bi same became mighty men yaḥ vṛt sya old, men asya renown.
ù bhagavān paś tad bi wickedness ak manuṣya bhū gal a bi bhūmi, api ne every imagination sya sa thoughts ak tasya heart gál only evil continually.
u3 idam repented eṣa ensi ne eṣa had gag guruš on sa pṛthivī, ca ne grieved him at asya heart.
ca bi svāmin vac, i will destroy guruš whom i have dù prabhṛti sa mukha ak sa ki; both lú, u3 beast, tathā bi creeping thing, ca bi fowls asya eṣa air; arthạm ne repenteth me ne i have dim bi-ne.
but noah found grace a tad eyes ak bi nātha.
these are eṣa generations sya noah: noah gál a just manuṣya u3 perfect antar asya generations, u3 noah walked da bhagavān.
api noah begat three putra, shem, ham, tathā japheth.
bi ki also as corrupt before bhagavān, ca tad ki vṛt filled ù violence.
tathā deva looked upari bi pṛthivī, ù, behold, idam me corrupt; šè niĝ flesh had corrupted tasya way ugu tad uraš.
ù dingir vac šè noah, sa end ak viśva flesh is gin before me; mu bi uraš is filled sahita violence through bi-ne; ù, behold, i will destroy tān saha sa ki.
dù thee an ark asya gopher wood; rooms shalt thou dim ša eṣa ark, ù shalt pitch ne within u3 rahita da pitch.
ca etat is bi fashion ša thou shalt dim idam ak: bi length ak bi ark shall vṛt three hundred cubits, bi breadth ak tat fifty cubits, tathā tad height sya ne thirty cubits.
a window shalt thou vidh šè tad ark, api a a cubit shalt thou finish idam upari; tathā bi door ak eṣa ark shalt thou set madhye bi side thereof; da lower, min, ca eš stories shalt thou nirmā bi.
ù, behold, i, even i, do bring a flood asya jala upari bi pṛthivī, šè destroy niĝ flesh, wherein is sa breath sya prāṇa, ta ki-ta anu; ca every thing iri is a tad kalam shall ug7.
but sahita thee will i establish my covenant; tathā thou shalt du a bi ark, thou, ù thy putra, ca thy wife, ca thy sons' wives ù thee.
u3 asya every living thing ak sarva flesh, dvau ak every sort shalt thou bring praviśya eṣa ark, abhimukham keep etān alive sahita thee; they shall gál male ca female.
sya fowls after bi-meš kind, api asya cattle after bi-meš kind, asya every creeping thing ak bi uraš after ani kind, dvau ak every sort shall prāp prati thee, šè keep tān alive.
ù take thou prati thee sya sarva food tad is eaten, tathā thou shalt saṃgṛh bi šè thee; tathā ne shall me arthạm food mu thee, ù arthạm tān.
thus did noah; according prati sakala tad dingir commanded him, evam did bi.
u3 sa lugal dug4 abhimukham noah, āyā thou tathā gištug thy sadana antar eṣa ark; arthạm thee have i dṛś righteous before me ša bi generation.
ak every clean beast thou shalt take abhimukham thee by sevens, bi male u3 tasya female: ù asya beasts tad are na clean by dvau, bi male tathā tasya female.
ak fowls also ak sa air by sevens, sa male api tad female; šè keep seed alive šu-ba bi igi ak niĝ tad dharā.
kṛte yet seven days, ù i will cause tat šè rain par tad pṛthivī forty days ca forty nights; api every living substance yad i have dù will i destroy ta off eṣa pa sya eṣa bhūmi.
api noah did according abhimukham sarva yad bi svāmin commanded him.
api noah bhū six hundred years old when sa flood ak ap as šu-ba eṣa dharā.
u3 noah yā ša, u3 asya putra, ù tasya wife, u3 bi sons' wives da him, praviśya eṣa ark, because ak bi a sya bi flood.
asya clean beasts, u3 sya beasts ne are mā clean, api ak fowls, u3 ak every thing ne creepeth par bi uraš,
tatra gen ša dvi u3 min šè noah antar bi ark, tad male tathā tad female, as deva had commanded noah.
ù idam du prati pass after seven days, iri bi udaka ak bi flood gál upari tad dharā.
antar bi six hundredth year sya noah's prāṇa, ša eṣa dvi month, sa seventeenth dina ak bi month, bi same u4 me šu eṣa fountains sya bi mahā abzu broken up, api bi windows ak svarga gál opened.
u3 bi rain me upari eṣa kalam forty days u3 forty nights.
a bi selfsame dina entered noah, api shem, api ham, ù japheth, tad dumu ak noah, api noah's wife, u3 sa three wives asya asya dumu da bi-ne, šè bi ark;

they, u3 every beast after tasya kind, ù gištug sa cattle after teṣām kind, u3 every creeping thing yad creepeth šu-ba bi kalam after ani kind, u3 every fowl after bi kind, every bird asya every sort.
api they gam ša prati noah antar bi ark, min api dvau sya sarva flesh, wherein is bi breath ak ti.
api they tad du ša, gam a male api female sya gištug flesh, as bhagavān had commanded him: u3 tad ensi shut him a.
tathā bi flood gál forty days par sa dharā; ù bi ap increased, tathā bare up bi ark, tathā tat me lift up ūrdhva bi bhūmi.
tathā bi jala prevailed, ca gál increased greatly ugu bi uraš; ca tad ark vraj upari bi igi sya sa ídim.
ù sa jala prevailed exceedingly par tad dharā; tathā šu eṣa high hills, ne me ki-ta eṣa whole svarga, gál covered.
fifteen cubits upward did eṣa a prevail; api sa mountains as covered.
u3 gištug flesh died yad gam par sa dharā, both ak fowl, u3 ak cattle, u3 sya beast, ca ak every creeping thing tad creepeth upari sa bhūmi, tathā every manuṣya:
šu ša whose nostrils as bi breath ak nam-ti, ak gištug ne bhū ša tad bad kur, died.

ca every living substance me destroyed yad bhū ugu bi vadana ak bi ground, both nitadam, u3 cattle, u3 bi creeping things, ca tad fowl ak sa dyau; tathā they as destroyed ta eṣa uraš: tathā noah only remained alive, tathā they yad me sahita him a bi ark.
ù sa a prevailed ugu tad ki an hundred ù fifty days.
u3 deva remembered noah, api every living thing, ù viśva sa cattle iri gál saha him madhye bi ark: tathā ilum dim a wind šè pass over sa ki, tathā tad ídim asswaged;
tad fountains also ak eṣa gambhīra api bi windows sya anu as stopped, u3 sa rain tas an me restrained;
u3 sa a returned ta off bi dharā continually: tathā after sa end asya sa hundred tathā fifty days eṣa ídim gál abated.
ca bi ark rested a eṣa seventh month, on sa seventeenth ud ak tad month, par tad mountains ak ararat.
ù bi a decreased continually until tad tenth month: ša sa tenth month, on sa ādya u4 ak eṣa month, bhū sa tops ak bi mountains lok.
ca tat è šè pass at eṣa end ak forty days, ne noah opened bi window ak eṣa ark yaḥ ani had gag:
ù sa sent forth a raven, yaḥ gam forth prati api fro, until sa udaka vṛt dried up ta off bi pṛthivī.
also bi sent forth a dove ta him, prati igi if tad jala me abated prabhṛti off bi igi ak bi ground;

but bi dove found na rest mu bi sole ak asyāḥ foot, tathā she returned prati him praviśya eṣa ark, mu bi ídim gál on bi igi ak bi whole kalam: then bi put forth ani hand, api took tasyāḥ, ca pulled ani-munus a prati him praviśya bi ark.
ù bi stayed yet other seven days; ù again sa sent forth bi dove bar sya bi ark;
tathā sa dove è a šè him antar sa sandhyā; api, lo, madhye tasyāḥ mouth me an olive leaf pluckt off: ga-nam noah knew yad bi a gál abated ta off bi kalam.
api eṣa stayed yet other seven days; tathā sent forth tad dove; lú returned nu again šè him any more.

api idam prāp abhimukham pass antar bi six hundredth tathā 1-kam year, antar bi 1-kam month, eṣa prathama ud ak eṣa month, sa ap vṛt dried up tas off eṣa pṛthivī: ù noah removed tad covering ak sa ark, ca looked, ù, behold, bi mukha asya tad ground as ḫad.
tathā antar tad 2-kam month, on bi seven tathā twentieth u4 asya bi month, as bi ki dried.
u3 bhagavān spake šè noah, e,
è forth asya sa ark, thou, ù thy wife, ca thy ibila, tathā thy sons' wives ù thee.

bring forth ù thee every living thing tad is da thee, ak gištug flesh, both ak fowl, ù ak cattle, api sya every creeping thing yad creepeth upari sa dharā; ne they may breed abundantly madhye bi dharā, ù gál fruitful, api multiply par sa bhūmi.
ù noah du forth, u3 ani ibila, ca tasya wife, u3 bi sons' wives ù him:
every beast, every creeping thing, ù every fowl, tathā whatsoever creepeth šu-ba tad ki, after bi-meš kinds, yā forth bahis ak bi ark.
tathā noah builded an altar abhimukham bi svāmin; api took ak every clean beast, u3 asya every clean fowl, u3 offered burnt offerings on bi altar.

ù eṣa ensi smelled a sweet savour; tathā tad en e antar ani heart, i will ul again curse bi ground any more arthạm man's sake; šè bi imagination ak man's heart is evil prabhṛti ani youth; neither will i again smite any more every thing living, as i have done.
while sa pṛthivī remaineth, seedtime u3 harvest, u3 cold api heat, u3 summer tathā winter, ca divasa u3 ge6 shall ul cease.
ca bhagavān blessed noah u3 tasya dumu, tathā dug4 šè etān, gál fruitful, u3 multiply, u3 replenish tad kalam.

ca bi fear ak you u3 tad dread ak you shall gál ugu every beast asya bi pṛthivī, tathā šu-ba every fowl sya tad air, upari gištug tad moveth par bi dharā, ù upari niĝ eṣa fishes asya bi sea; a your hand are they delivered.
every moving thing yad liveth shall as meat kṛte you; even as bi green herb have i given you niĝ things.
but flesh sahita sa āyus thereof, ša is bi blood thereof, shall ye na eat.
u3 surely your blood sya your lives will i require; at bi hand ak every beast will i require tat, u3 at eṣa hand ak nara; at sa hand ak every man's brother will i require bi ti sya nitadam.
whoso sheddeth man's blood, by nara shall tasya blood as shed: kṛte antar bi image ak an gag sa nitadam.
u3 you, as ye fruitful, tathā multiply; bring forth abundantly a tad ki, ca multiply therein.
ù īśvara spake šè noah, api šè tasya suta ù him, kathay,
u3 i, behold, i establish my covenant da you, u3 sahita your seed after you;
api saha every living creature yad is ù you, asya sa fowl, sya sa cattle, ù asya every beast sya bi ki saha you; prabhṛti sarva ne gen bahis ak tad ark, šè every beast sya sa pṛthivī.
ù i will establish my covenant saha you; neither shall niĝ flesh bhū cut off any more by tad jala ak a flood; neither shall ni any more as a flood prati destroy bi dharā.
tathā ilum vac, ne is bi token ak bi covenant ša i dim between me api you u3 every living creature ne is da you, kṛte perpetual generations:
i do set my bow madhye bi cloud, ca bi shall vṛt arthạm a token sya a covenant between me tathā eṣa uraš.
ù idam shall āyā abhimukham pass, when i bring a cloud over bi kalam, yad eṣa bow shall gál paś antar eṣa cloud:
ca i will remember my covenant, yaḥ is between me tathā you u3 every living creature ak sakala flesh; tathā bi a shall na more become a flood šè destroy niĝ flesh.
api bi bow shall bhū ša bi cloud; tathā i will look ugu idam, tad i may remember tad everlasting covenant between deva ù every living creature ak niĝ flesh tad is ugu eṣa dharā.
u3 deva inim abhimukham noah, ne is tad token asya bi covenant, ša i have established between me tathā viśva flesh iri is upari eṣa pṛthivī.
u3 bi suta asya noah, ne vraj forth ak bi ark, as shem, ù ham, ù japheth: ù ham is eṣa father asya canaan.
these are bi three ātmaja sya noah: ù ak tān gál eṣa whole pṛthivī overspread.
ù noah began prati me an husbandman, tathā bi planted a vineyard:
api eṣa drank sya eṣa wine, u3 me drunken; tathā eṣa gál uncovered within ani tent.
ù ham, tad father ak canaan, lok sa nakedness sya asya father, ù told asya min brethren vinā.

tathā shem u3 japheth took a garment, ù laid idam šu-ba both bi-meš shoulders, api gen backward, ù covered tad nakedness asya bi-meš father; ù teṣām faces me backward, ù they dṛś mā bi-meš father's nakedness.
ù noah awoke ta ani wine, ù knew what tasya younger dumu had done prati him.
ca bi e, cursed as canaan; a servant sya servants shall eṣa vṛt šè tasya brethren.
u3 bi kathay, blessed bhū bi svāmin īśvara sya shem; u3 canaan shall gál bi servant.
bhagavān shall enlarge japheth, u3 sa shall dwell madhye tad tents sya shem; tathā canaan shall vṛt tasya servant.
tathā noah lived after bi flood three hundred tathā fifty years.
tathā šu eṣa days asya noah as nine hundred u3 fifty years: ca eṣa died.
now these are bi generations sya bi dumu asya noah, shem, ham, ù japheth: ca prati bi-ne me dumu born after tad flood.
bi ibila sya japheth; gomer, tathā magog, api madai, tathā javan, ù tubal, ca meshech, ù tiras.
api bi dumu ak gomer; ashkenaz, ù riphath, ca togarmah.
u3 bi ātmaja ak javan; elishah, ù tarshish, kittim, ù dodanim.
by these me bi isles sya bi gentiles ba madhye bi-meš lands; every aš after tasya tongue, after eṣām families, a bi-meš nations.
u3 bi ātmaja ak ham; cush, u3 mizraim, u3 phut, ù canaan.
ù sa suta ak cush; seba, api havilah, ù sabtah, tathā raamah, ca sabtechah: u3 tad ibila sya raamah; sheba, ca dedan.
tathā cush begat nimrod: sa began abhimukham as a mighty aš madhye bi pṛthivī.
ani me a mighty hunter before bi ensi: wherefore bi is dug4, even as nimrod bi mighty hunter before eṣa svāmin.
ca eṣa sag sya tasya kingdom as babel, tathā erech, u3 accad, u3 calneh, antar bi deśa ak shinar.
bāhya ak yad kalam du forth asshur, u3 builded nineveh, u3 tad city rehoboth, ca calah,
u3 resen between nineveh tathā calah: bi same is a mahā city.
u3 mizraim begat ludim, u3 anamim, u3 lehabim, ù naphtuhim,
api pathrusim, ù casluhim, (out sya whom è philistim ,) tathā caphtorim.
api canaan begat sidon asya ādya born, api heth,
u3 sa jebusite, tathā tad amorite, ù eṣa girgasite,
u3 bi hivite, tathā sa arkite, u3 sa sinite,
api bi arvadite, u3 bi zemarite, u3 bi hamathite: ca afterward gál bi families sya bi canaanites spread abroad.
u3 tad border asya sa canaanites as tas sidon, as thou comest šè gerar, šè gaza; as thou goest, prati sodom, api gomorrah, ù admah, api zeboim, even šè lasha.
these are bi ibila ak ham, after bi-meš families, after bi-meš tongues, a teṣām countries, ca ša eṣām nations.
prati shem also, bi father asya sakala bi children ak eber, tad brother ak japheth tad elder, even šè him gál children born.
bi children ak shem; elam, u3 asshur, ù arphaxad, u3 lud, ù aram.
u3 tad children asya aram; uz, u3 hul, u3 gether, api mash.
u3 arphaxad begat salah; u3 salah begat eber.
ca šè eber gál born dvau dumu: sa name ak prathama me peleg; arthạm madhye tasya days me eṣa pṛthivī sag-ki; tathā asya brother's name vṛt joktan.
ù joktan begat almodad, ù sheleph, ù hazarmaveth, u3 jerah,
tathā hadoram, ca uzal, ù diklah,
tathā obal, ù abimael, ù sheba,
ca ophir, ù havilah, tathā jobab: gištug these me bi dumu ak joktan.
ca bi-meš dwelling gál ta mesha, as thou goest šè sephar a mount ak bi east.
these are bi dumu asya shem, after bi-meš families, after bi-meš tongues, ša teṣām lands, after teṣām nations.
these are tad families asya sa putra ak noah, after teṣām generations, ša bi-meš nations: ù by these bhū tad nations vibhaj ša tad uraš after tad flood.
ca eṣa whole uraš vṛt ak prathama language, ca ak prathama speech.
u3 tat du abhimukham pass, as they journeyed ta bi east, tad they found a plain antar tad bhū ak shinar; u3 they dwelt atra.
tathā they brū diš abhimukham another, yā šè, anujñā us dù brick, api burn bi-ne thoroughly. ù they had brick šè stone, api slime had they kṛte morter.
api they vac, vraj prati, anujñā us build us a city u3 a tower, whose top may reach šè naka; ca anujñā us dim us a name, lest we bhū scattered abroad par tad pa sya bi whole dharā.
u3 eṣa prabhu prāp down prati igi bi city tathā eṣa tower, lú eṣa children ak men builded.
ca eṣa prabhu vac, behold, bi jana is aš, tathā they have niĝ eka language; tathā etat they begin abhimukham do: ù now nothing will as restrained ta tān, ša they have imagined šè do.
è prati, he-me us vraj down, tathā tatra confound eṣām language, ne they may nu understand aš another's speech.
evam bi lugal scattered bi-ne abroad ta thence upari bi pa asya viśva tad ki: ca they left off šè build tad city.
therefore is eṣa name sya ne gu3-dé babel; because sa ensi did tatra confound sa language ak sakala bi kalam: ca tas thence did bi en scatter bi-ne abroad upari tad mukha asya sarva eṣa ki.
these are bi generations ak shem: shem as an hundred years old, ca begat arphaxad dvau years after bi flood:
tathā shem lived after sa begat arphaxad five hundred years, tathā begat ātmaja ca daughters.
u3 arphaxad lived five ca thirty years, ù begat salah:
u3 arphaxad lived after sa begat salah four hundred u3 three years, u3 begat putra ca daughters.
ù salah lived thirty years, ù begat eber:
ca salah lived after ayam begat eber four hundred ù three years, ù begat dumu ù daughters.
ca eber lived four tathā thirty years, api begat peleg:
ù eber lived after ani begat peleg four hundred tathā thirty years, u3 begat ibila ca daughters.
ca peleg lived thirty years, tathā begat reu:
u3 peleg lived after bi begat reu dvi hundred u3 nine years, tathā begat ibila u3 daughters.
ù reu lived min tathā thirty years, tathā begat serug:
u3 reu lived after eṣa begat serug min hundred api seven years, ca begat dumu u3 daughters.
u3 serug lived thirty years, api begat nahor:
ù serug lived after bi begat nahor dvi hundred years, api begat ibila api daughters.
ca nahor lived nine api twenty years, ù begat terah:
tathā nahor lived after ani begat terah an hundred ca nineteen years, tathā begat putra u3 daughters.
u3 terah lived seventy years, ca begat abram, nahor, ù haran.
now these are tad generations ak terah: terah begat abram, nahor, tathā haran; u3 haran begat lot.
ù haran died before bi father terah madhye bi pradeśa ak asya nativity, antar ur asya bi chaldees.
u3 abram ca nahor took tān wives: eṣa name ak abram's wife gál sarai; ù eṣa name sya nahor's wife, milcah, sa daughter ak haran, eṣa father ak milcah, ù eṣa father ak iscah.
but sarai me barren; she had nu child.

tathā terah took abram bi ibila, ù lot bi dumu ak haran ani son's suta, ù sarai bi daughter ša law, ani dumu abram's wife; api they du forth da bi-ne ta ur ak tad chaldees, šè vraj šè sa kalam asya canaan; ù they ā-gam prati haran, u3 dwelt tatra.
u3 bi days ak terah gál min hundred u3 five years: tathā terah died antar haran.
now tad nātha had inim šè abram, get thee bahis sya thy country, u3 ta thy kindred, u3 prabhṛti thy father's gṛha, šè a pradeśa iri i will shew thee:
api i will dim asya thee a bṛhat nation, ù i will bless thee, ca dù thy name mahā; u3 thou shalt gál a blessing:
api i will bless bi-ne tad bless thee, ca curse him tad curseth thee: api madhye thee shall sarva families ak eṣa ki as blessed.
ga-nam abram departed, as sa ensi had spoken prati him; api lot gam ù him: u3 abram as seventy u3 five years old when sa departed è sya haran.

api abram took sarai tasya wife, api lot ani brother's dumu, u3 šu teṣām substance iri they had saṃgṛh, tathā bi souls tad they had gotten a haran; ca they yā forth prati vraj praviśya tad deśa ak canaan; api antar bi kur asya canaan they āyā.
api abram passed through eṣa pradeśa šè eṣa ki sya sichem, prati tad plain sya moreh. tathā sa canaanite me then a bi kur.
u3 bi prabhu appeared prati abram, ca e, šè thy seed will i give bi pradeśa: ca ni builded eṣa an altar abhimukham sa svāmin, who appeared abhimukham him.

tathā ani removed tas thence prati a mountain on bi east sya bethel, ca pitched ani tent, having bethel on bi west, u3 hai on tad east: u3 ni ayam builded an altar abhimukham tad prabhu, ù mu-ù ugu sa name ak tad lugal.
ca abram journeyed, going on still toward bi south.
tathā atra me a famine a eṣa pradeśa: ù abram è down praviśya egypt šè sojourn atra; kṛte tad famine gál grievous antar tad kur.
api tat du prati pass, when eṣa bhū gin near šè enter šè egypt, ne bi kathay šè sarai bi wife, behold now, i know tad thou art a fair nārī šè look upari:
therefore idam shall è prati pass, when eṣa egyptians shall igi-du8 thee, ne they shall kathay, idam is bi wife: ca they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.
inim, i pray thee, thou art my sister: yad idam may me well da me kṛte thy sake; ù my soul shall jīv because ak thee.
ù idam è prati pass, iri, when abram bhū gin praviśya egypt, bi egyptians beheld bi dam ne she vṛt very fair.
sa princes also sya pharaoh igi ani-munus, ù commended ani-munus before pharaoh: api bi strī vṛt taken antar pharaoh's ki-gal.
ca ayam entreated abram well mu asyāḥ sake: api ayam had sheep, ù oxen, u3 ayam asses, tathā menservants, u3 maidservants, api she asses, api camels.
api bi nātha plagued pharaoh ca ani geh da mahā plagues because ak sarai abram's wife.
api pharaoh gu3-dé abram, ù brū, what is etat yad thou hast done prati me? why didst thou mā tell me ne she gál thy wife?
why saidst thou, she is my sister? nu-me i might have taken asyāḥ šè me šè wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take asyāḥ, u3 yā thy way.
ca pharaoh commanded tasya men concerning him: tathā they sent him away, ca tasya wife, u3 viśva yad eṣa had.
u3 abram gen up è ak egypt, bi, u3 asya wife, ù sakala iri ani had, ù lot saha him, antar sa south.
ù abram vṛt very rich a cattle, madhye silver, tathā a gold.
u3 bi du on bi journeys tas bi south even šè bethel, prati tad deśa where ani tent had as at bi pa-è, between bethel ù hai;
abhimukham bi ki sya bi altar, lú bi had vidh ne at tad 1-kam: ca ne abram gu3-dé on bi name ak bi prabhu.
ù lot also, lú du da abram, had flocks, u3 herds, tathā tents.
ca bi bhū me nu able šè bear etān, yad they might dwell saha: mu teṣām substance as mahā, ittham yad they could mā dwell saha.
ca ne me a strife between sa herdmen asya abram's cattle ù eṣa herdmen ak lot's cattle: u3 bi canaanite tathā sa perizzite dwelled then madhye tad kalam.
api abram inim prati lot, he-me atra me nu strife, i pray thee, between me api thee, u3 between my herdmen ù thy herdmen; arthạm we gál brethren.

is nu bi whole pradeśa before thee? separate thyself, i pray thee, ta me: if thou wilt take tad left hand, then i will vraj abhimukham bi right; or if thou depart šè tad right hand, then i will gam prati tad left.

ù lot lifted up ani eyes, u3 beheld niĝ bi plain ak jordan, yad ne me well watered every where, before bi lugal destroyed sodom api gomorrah, even as bi garden ak eṣa prabhu, like bi bhū ak egypt, as thou comest prati zoar.
then lot chose him sarva tad plain ak jordan; api lot journeyed east: api they separated themselves bi diš ta eṣa other.
abram dwelled ša eṣa pradeśa ak canaan, ca lot dwelled ša sa cities ak sa plain, tathā pitched ani tent toward sodom.
but bi men asya sodom as wicked u3 sinners before sa svāmin exceedingly.
api eṣa svāmin dug4 abhimukham abram, after ne lot vṛt separated prabhṛti him, lift up now thine eyes, ù look ta bi sthāna where thou art northward, tathā southward, api eastward, tathā westward:
arthạm sakala bi kur ša thou seest, šè thee will i give tat, api prati thy seed mu ever.
tathā i will dim thy seed as bi dust ak tad dharā: evam tad if a puruṣa can number bi dust asya eṣa bhūmi, then shall thy seed also me numbered.
arise, walk through bi deśa madhye bi length asya bi ù a eṣa breadth sya tat; šè i will give tat prati thee.
then abram removed tasya tent, ca gin tathā dwelt madhye bi plain ak mamre, yaḥ is a hebron, ca built tatra an altar šè bi en.
u3 tat du abhimukham pass a bi days ak amraphel bhūpati ak shinar, arioch rāja sya ellasar, chedorlaomer lugal ak elam, ù tidal lugal ak nations;
tad these gag war sahita bera nṛpa ak sodom, ca da birsha bhūpati sya gomorrah, shinab bhūpati asya admah, u3 shemeber nṛpa ak zeboiim, u3 sa bhūpati ak bela, yad is zoar.
niĝ these as joined saṃyuktam ša bi vale asya siddim, ša is sa salt sea.
twelve years they served chedorlaomer, ca ša bi thirteenth year they rebelled.
u3 ša eṣa fourteenth year gin chedorlaomer, u3 eṣa kings tad bhū saha him, ca smote tad rephaims antar ashteroth karnaim, ca bi zuzims ša ham, tathā eṣa emims madhye shaveh kiriathaim,
api tad horites madhye bi-meš mount seir, prati elparan, yad is by eṣa wilderness.
ca they returned, u3 è abhimukham enmishpat, ša is kadesh, api smote sakala tad country asya bi amalekites, ù also sa amorites, ne dwelt ša hazezontamar.

api tatra du bāhya bi ensi ak sodom, ù eṣa ensi ak gomorrah, ù eṣa bhūpati ak admah, u3 tad rāja ak zeboiim, api bi lugal sya bela (the same is zoar ;) u3 they joined battle ù bi-ne a bi vale sya siddim;
ù chedorlaomer eṣa nṛpa asya elam, ù sahita tidal ensi asya nations, ca amraphel rāja asya shinar, ca arioch ensi asya ellasar; four kings da five.
u3 tad vale ak siddim me full sya slimepits; ca sa kings asya sodom u3 gomorrah fled, ù fell ni; ù they ne remained fled abhimukham tad mountain.
ca they took viśva bi goods asya sodom tathā gomorrah, api niĝ teṣām victuals, ca yā teṣām way.
ca they took lot, abram's brother's putra, who dwelt antar sodom, tathā ani goods, tathā departed.
tathā ni āyā diš tad had escaped, u3 told abram sa hebrew; arthạm sa dwelt a bi plain ak mamre bi amorite, brother sya eshcol, u3 brother ak aner: api these gál confederate saha abram.
ù when abram heard tad ani brother vṛt taken captive, eṣa armed asya trained servants, born a tasya own ki-gal, three hundred ù eighteen, tathā pursued etān šè dan.
u3 sa sag-ki himself against tān, eṣa ca tasya servants, by ge6, ca smote bi-ne, ù pursued bi-ne prati hobah, lú is on sa left hand ak damascus.
ù bi brought back sarva eṣa goods, ù also brought again ani brother lot, u3 tasya goods, u3 sa women also, u3 sa prajā.
u3 tad rāja ak sodom du bar abhimukham meet him after asya return ta eṣa slaughter asya chedorlaomer, ù sya bi kings iri bhū saha him, at sa valley ak shaveh, ša is bi king's dale.
ca melchizedek ensi ak salem brought forth bread ca wine: tathā ayam vṛt eṣa priest ak tad most high īśvara.
ù sa blessed him, u3 kathay, blessed vṛt abram ak sa most high an, possessor ak svarga ù dharā:
u3 blessed bhū tad most high īśvara, yaḥ hath delivered thine enemies praviśya thy hand. api bi gave him tithes asya šu.
ù eṣa nṛpa ak sodom kathay šè abram, give me sa persons, ca take bi goods šè thyself.
ù abram inim prati sa rāja ak sodom, i have lift up mine hand abhimukham eṣa lugal, bi most high īśvara, bi possessor asya dyau ù uraš,
ne i will nu take ta a thread even šè a shoelatchet, u3 ne i will na take any thing tad is thine, lest thou shouldest inim, i have vidh abram rich:
save only iri lú eṣa young men have eaten, ù bi portion asya bi men lú vraj ù me, aner, eshcol, api mamre; dā tān take bi-meš portion.
after these things eṣa word sya sa en gin šè abram madhye a vision, e, fear nu, abram: i am thy shield, u3 thy exceeding mahā reward.
ù abram vac, lugal deva, what wilt thou give me, seeing i gen childless, tathā tad steward ak my ki-gal is idam eliezer ak damascus?
api abram vac, behold, prati me thou hast given na seed: ù, lo, diš born antar my é is mine heir.
ca, behold, bi word sya sa nātha ā-gam šè him, dug4, etat shall nu me thine heir; but bi ne shall gin forth bahis ak thine own bowels shall gál thine heir.
u3 ani brought him forth abroad, tathā kathay, look now toward svarga, ù tell tad stars, if thou gál able šè number bi-ne: u3 ani dug4 abhimukham him, evam shall thy seed me.
u3 bi believed ša bi nātha; tathā ani counted idam abhimukham him mu righteousness.

my lugal, hearken šè me: bi deśa is worth four hundred shekels sya silver; what is ne betwixt me u3 thee? bury therefore thy dead.

u3 bi servant took ten camels ak bi camels ak ani master, tathā departed; kṛte viśva tad goods sya ani master me a asya hand: tathā ani arose, ù vraj šè mesopotamia, šè bi city asya nahor.

šè she had e prati bi servant, what nitadam is idam tad walketh ša bi field šè meet us? tathā tad servant had brū, idam is my master: therefore she took a vail, u3 covered herself.

u3 ani dumu isaac tathā ishmael buried him madhye bi cave asya machpelah, a sa field asya ephron bi ibila ak zohar bi hittite, lú is before mamre;

u3 jacob sod pottage: ù esau prāp ta bi field, api ayam vṛt faint:
u3 esau dug4 šè jacob, feed me, i pray thee, saha iri same red pottage; arthạm i am faint: therefore me ani name gu3-dé edom.
ca jacob inim, sell me etat ud thy birthright.
u3 esau e, behold, i am at bi point šè ug7: api what profit shall bi birthright do abhimukham me?
u3 jacob e, swear šè me etat ud; api bi sware prati him: ù eṣa sold ani birthright prati jacob.

tathā ni me a famine antar bi pradeśa, beside sa 1-kam famine tad vṛt madhye bi days ak abraham. ù isaac è šè abimelech lugal ak bi philistines abhimukham gerar.
u3 bi en appeared prati him, api dug4, yā na down antar egypt; dwell antar bi pradeśa yaḥ i shall tell thee asya:

sojourn antar idam deśa, ca i will as sahita thee, u3 will bless thee; arthạm abhimukham thee, ca abhimukham thy seed, i will give sarva these countries, u3 i will perform bi oath lú i sware prati abraham thy father;
ca i will nirmā thy seed šè multiply as bi stars ak an, ù will give šè thy seed niĝ these countries; u3 ša thy seed shall gištug tad nations asya tad pṛthivī gál blessed;
because ne abraham obeyed my voice, tathā kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, ù my laws.
ca isaac dwelt madhye gerar:

api sa men sya bi šà asked him ak bi wife; ù ayam inim, she is my sister: mu ani feared šè dug4, she is my wife; lest, inim bi, eṣa men sya bi deśa should kill me kṛte rebekah; because she as fair šè look šu-ba.
tathā idam prāp šè pass, when sa had gál atra a long time, ne abimelech bhūpati sya sa philistines looked bar at a window, api lok, u3, behold, isaac me sporting ù rebekah tasya wife.
ù abimelech gu3-dé isaac, ù kathay, behold, asya a surety she is thy wife: tathā how saidst thou, she is my sister? ù isaac kathay šè him, because i kathay, lest i úš kṛte ani-munus.

but when bi cattle gál feeble, ayam put bi-ne mā ša: ittham bi feebler bhū laban's, u3 bi stronger jacob's.

ca ayam heard bi words sya laban's ibila, dug4, jacob hath taken away niĝ tad bhū our father's; ù ak yad ša me our father's hath eṣa gotten šu etat glory.
tathā jacob beheld sa countenance ak laban, tathā, behold, ne gál na toward him as before.
u3 bi lugal e prati jacob, return šè eṣa kalam ak thy fathers, ù prati thy kindred; ù i will as saha thee.
ù jacob sent ca āhva rachel ca leah šè bi field šè ani flock,
ca brū šè bi-ne, i igi-du8 your father's countenance, yad idam is mā toward me as before; but bi īśvara ak my father hath me saha me.
u3 ye know tad ù niĝ my power i have served your father.
ù your father hath deceived me, ca changed my wages ten times; but deva suffered him na abhimukham hurt me.
if ani kathay thus, tad speckled shall vṛt thy wages; then sarva eṣa cattle bare speckled: u3 if ani vac thus, tad ringstraked shall me thy hire; then bare sarva bi cattle ringstraked.
thus ilum hath taken away sa cattle asya your father, u3 given tān prati me.
api ne du šè pass at bi time yad eṣa cattle conceived, ne i lifted up mine eyes, ù dṛś ša a dream, ù, behold, bi rams ša leaped šu-ba bi cattle vṛt ringstraked, speckled, ù grisled.
ù eṣa angel sya an spake prati me antar a dream, brū, jacob: tathā i e, here am i.
tathā sa vac, lift up now thine eyes, ù dṛś, sakala bi rams ša leap šu-ba sa cattle are ringstraked, speckled, u3 grisled: arthạm i have igi-du8 sarva iri laban doeth šè thee.
i am bi īśvara asya bethel, where thou anointedst bi pillar, u3 where thou vowedst a vow prati me: now arise, get thee bāhya ta bi kur, u3 return prati bi kur ak thy kindred.
ca rachel tathā leah answered ù vac šè him, is tatra yet any portion or inheritance šè us antar our father's ki-gal?
are we ul counted sya him strangers? šè ani hath sold us, tathā hath quite devoured also our money.
mu viśva bi riches ša dingir hath taken tas our father, tad is ours, u3 our children's: now then, whatsoever īśvara hath dug4 abhimukham thee, do.
then jacob rose up, ù set tasya suta tathā ani wives par camels;

u3 sa carried away viśva asya cattle, api viśva ani goods yad sa had gotten, bi cattle ak ani getting, yaḥ ani had gotten a padanaram, mu abhimukham yā abhimukham isaac ani father ša bi pradeśa ak canaan.
ca laban gam šè shear ani sheep: ca rachel had stolen eṣa images yad as ani-munus father's.
ca jacob stole away unawares šè laban bi syrian, ša yad ayam told him mā tad bi fled.
ga-nam eṣa fled ù niĝ ne sa had; ù ayam rose up, u3 passed over tad river, ù set ani pa toward tad mount gilead.
ù ne vṛt told laban on sa 3-kam u4 iri jacob bhū fled.
u3 ani took bi brethren ù him, ù pursued after him seven days' journey; api they overtook him a bi mount gilead.
u3 dingir du šè laban bi syrian a a dream by gi6, ca dug4 prati him, take heed ne thou speak mā prati jacob either sādhu or bad.
then laban overtook jacob. now jacob had pitched tasya tent madhye bi mount: u3 laban sahita ani brethren pitched antar bi mount ak gilead.
u3 laban dug4 abhimukham jacob, what hast thou done, iri thou hast stolen away unawares abhimukham me, ca carried away my daughters, as captives taken da eṣa sword?
wherefore didst thou flee away secretly, ù steal away ta me; ca didst na tell me, tad i might have sent thee away ù mirth, api da songs, da tabret, ù da harp?
u3 hast ul suffered me šè kiss my dumu u3 my daughters? thou hast now done foolishly antar ittham doing.
idam is madhye bi power sya my hand abhimukham do you hurt: but bi deva sya your father spake šè me yesternight, vac, take thou heed iri thou speak na šè jacob either sundara or bad.
ca now, though thou wouldest needs vṛt gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father's sadana, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?
ù jacob answered u3 brū šè laban, because i as afraid: šè i inim, peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters prabhṛti me.
saha whomsoever thou findest thy gods, dā him na vṛt: before our brethren discern thou what is thine da me, u3 take idam prati thee. šè jacob knew ul ne rachel had stolen bi-ne.
ù laban vraj a jacob's tent, ù antar leah's tent, u3 a bi dvau maidservants' tents; but bi found bi-ne nu. then yā sa è ak leah's tent, u3 entered praviśya rachel's tent.
now rachel had taken bi images, api put etān ša eṣa camel's furniture, ù sat ugu etān. tathā laban searched šu bi tent, but found tān mā.
ca she inim šè ani-munus father, anujñā ne nu displease my svāmin yad i cannot rise up before thee; arthạm sa custom asya women is par me. u3 sa searched, but found nu bi images.
tathā jacob me wroth, api chode ù laban: ù jacob answered tathā inim prati laban, what is my trespass? what is my sin, ne thou hast ga-nam hotly pursued after me?
whereas thou hast searched gištug my stuff, what hast thou found sya viśva thy household stuff? set tat here before my brethren ca thy brethren, tad they may judge betwixt us both.
idam twenty years have i gál da thee; thy ewes ca thy she goats have mā cast bi-meš young, api bi rams asya thy flock have i ul eaten.
tad ša as torn sya beasts i brought na prati thee; i bare bi loss ak ne; ak my hand didst thou require bi, whether stolen by ahar, or stolen by niśā.
thus i me; madhye bi dina bi drought consumed me, api tad frost by niśā; ù my sleep departed ta mine eyes.
thus have i as twenty years ša thy ki-gal; i served thee fourteen years mu thy min daughters, u3 six years šè thy cattle: u3 thou hast changed my wages ten times.

except bi īśvara ak my father, eṣa dingir ak abraham, ca sa fear sya isaac, had vṛt sahita me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty. deva hath bar mine affliction u3 eṣa labour asya my hands, ù rebuked thee yesternight.

u3 laban answered tathā kathay prati jacob, these daughters are my daughters, ca these children are my children, api these cattle are my cattle, ca šu iri thou seest is mine: ù what can i do idam u4 abhimukham these my daughters, or prati eṣām children ša they have born?
now therefore prāp thou, dā us dù a covenant, i u3 thou; api dā ne bhū arthạm a witness between me tathā thee.
u3 jacob took a stone, tathā set tat up kṛte a pillar.
u3 jacob e abhimukham ani brethren, šum stones; u3 they took stones, ù dù an heap: ù they did eat ne upari eṣa heap.
u3 laban nam ne jegarsahadutha: but jacob āhva tat galeed.
tathā laban brū, idam heap is a witness between me u3 thee ne ud. therefore me bi name ak ne āhva galeed;
api mizpah; mu sa kathay, bi svāmin watch between me u3 thee, when we are absent aš prabhṛti another.
if thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters, nu nitadam is saha us; igi-du8, bhagavān is witness betwixt me ca thee.
tathā laban vac šè jacob, behold ne heap, ù behold idam pillar, yaḥ i have cast betwixt me tathā thee:
ne heap bhū witness, tathā bi pillar bhū witness, yad i will ul pass over etat heap prati thee, ù yad thou shalt na pass over idam heap ca ne pillar prati me, šè harm.
sa bhagavān ak abraham, ca bi bhagavān ak nahor, eṣa īśvara asya teṣām father, judge betwixt us. tathā jacob sware by bi fear ak tasya father isaac.
then jacob offered sacrifice šu-ba eṣa mount, tathā āhva tasya brethren abhimukham eat bread: ù they did eat bread, ù tarried gištug ge6 a bi mount.
ca early ša bi u4-ul-li laban rose up, u3 kissed asya dumu ù ani daughters, ca blessed etān: u3 laban departed, api returned prati tasya deśa.
ca jacob gam on ani way, api eṣa angels asya ilum met him.
u3 when jacob dṛś bi-ne, bi brū, ne is god's host: api ani nam tad name ak yad ki mahanaim.
u3 jacob sent messengers before him šè esau tasya brother prati eṣa kur sya seir, bi country sya edom.
u3 ayam commanded bi-ne, inim, thus shall ye speak abhimukham my svāmin esau; thy servant jacob saith thus, i have sojourned saha laban, api stayed ne until now:
tathā i have oxen, ù asses, flocks, api menservants, u3 womenservants: api i have sent šè tell my nātha, iri i may find grace madhye thy sight.
ca tad messengers returned šè jacob, e, we ā-gam prati thy brother esau, api also ani cometh abhimukham meet thee, ca four hundred men ù him.
then jacob bhū greatly afraid u3 distressed: api bi ba eṣa ukkin iri me saha him, api sa flocks, tathā herds, u3 sa camels, a min bands;
u3 brū, if esau è šè tad aš company, ca smite idam, then bi other company yad is left shall escape.
u3 jacob vac, o īśvara sya my father abraham, ù bhagavān ak my father isaac, bi prabhu yaḥ saidst prati me, return šè thy country, ca prati thy kindred, ca i will deal well da thee:
i am ul worthy sya bi least ak sarva bi mercies, api asya sarva eṣa truth, yad thou hast shewed abhimukham thy servant; arthạm saha my staff i passed over bi jordan; ù now i am become min bands.
deliver me, i pray thee, ta sa hand ak my brother, tas bi hand ak esau: arthạm i fear him, lest eṣa will gin u3 smite me, tathā bi mother ù eṣa children.
u3 thou saidst, i will surely do thee śubha, ca dim thy seed as sa sand ak bi sea, yad cannot gál numbered arthạm multitude.
ù sa lodged atra iri same niśā; tathā took asya ne yaḥ è prati tasya hand a present kṛte esau tasya brother;
dvi hundred she goats, tathā twenty ani goats, min hundred ewes, ù twenty rams,
thirty milch camels ù bi-meš colts, forty kine, ù ten bulls, twenty she asses, ù ten foals.
ca ayam delivered bi-ne a bi hand sya tasya servants, every drove by themselves; tathā vac šè asya servants, pass over before me, ca put a space betwixt drove ca drove.
ù ani commanded tad foremost, vac, when esau my brother meeteth thee, u3 asketh thee, brū, whose art thou? ù whither goest thou? u3 whose are these before thee?
then thou shalt kathay, they me thy servant jacob's; ne is a present sent prati my svāmin esau: ù, behold, also eṣa is behind us.
ù nu-me commanded eṣa tad min, ù sa 3-kam, tathā sakala tad followed bi droves, kathay, on ne manner shall ye speak šè esau, when ye find him.

tathā brū ye moreover, behold, thy servant jacob is behind us. šè ani brū, i will appease him ù bi present tad goeth before me, ca afterward i will bar tasya mukha; peradventure ayam will accept ak me.
ittham è bi present over before him: ù himself lodged yad rātri a sa company.

u3 ayam took tān, ca sent bi-ne over bi brook, u3 sent over ne ayam had.
api jacob me left alone; ù ne wrestled a nara saha him until tad breaking ak sa ahar.

tathā bi brū, dā me è, arthạm bi ud breaketh. ù ayam kathay, i will na he-me thee è, except thou bless me.
api eṣa dug4 šè him, what is thy name? tathā eṣa brū, jacob.

tathā jacob asked him, ù brū, tell me, i pray thee, thy name. tathā sa vac, wherefore is ne yad thou dost ask after my name? ù eṣa blessed him atra.
u3 jacob gu3-dé bi name ak tad sthāna peniel: mu i have igi an vadana šè igi, ù my jīvana is preserved.
ca as bi passed over penuel tad sun rose par him, u3 eṣa halted šu-ba ani thigh.
therefore bi children ak israel eat na ak bi sinew ša shrank, yad is šu-ba sa hollow asya eṣa thigh, šè etat ud: because ani touched eṣa hollow ak jacob's thigh madhye eṣa sinew tad shrank.
ca jacob lifted up tasya eyes, ca looked, ù, behold, esau è, u3 saha him four hundred men. ù ani chid bi children šè leah, u3 šè rachel, u3 šè sa dvau handmaids.
ca ani put tad handmaids u3 eṣām children foremost, api leah u3 ani-munus children after, ca rachel ù joseph hindermost.
api eṣa passed over before tān, tathā bowed himself šè bi ground seven times, until ani ā-gam near abhimukham tasya brother.
u3 esau ran abhimukham meet him, tathā embraced him, ca fell on bi neck, u3 kissed him: u3 they wept.
ca eṣa lifted up tasya eyes, ù bar bi women tathā bi children; api dug4, who are those sahita thee? ù ayam brū, bi children ša bhagavān hath graciously given thy servant.
then bi handmaidens ā-gam near, they ù bi-meš children, ca they bowed themselves.
ù leah also ù asyāḥ children gin near, api bowed themselves: u3 after prāp joseph near u3 rachel, ù they bowed themselves.
ca ani inim, what meanest thou by viśva bi drove yaḥ i met? u3 bi vac, these are šè find grace antar bi sight ak my lugal.
ù esau vac, i have enough, my brother; keep yad thou hast prati thyself.

ù jacob kathay, nay, i pray thee, if now i have found grace madhye thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: arthạm therefore i have igi thy igi, as though i had igi tad pa sya bhagavān, u3 thou wast pleased sahita me.
take, i pray thee, my blessing iri is brought šè thee; because bhagavān hath dealt graciously ù me, api because i have enough. api eṣa urged him, u3 ani took bi.
ca sa kathay, he-me us take our journey, ù dā us yā, u3 i will du before thee.
ca ayam inim abhimukham him, my en knoweth yad bi children are tender, ca bi flocks u3 herds sahita young are sahita me: ca if men should overdrive etān prathama u4, gištug sa flock will úš.

dā my svāmin, i pray thee, pass over before ani servant: ù i will lead on softly, according as sa cattle iri goeth before me tathā tad children gál able prati endure, until i prāp šè my svāmin abhimukham seir.
api esau inim, gá me now leave sahita thee some ak bi folk yad are da me. ù eṣa vac, what needeth ne? he-me me find grace madhye eṣa sight sya my en.
nu-me esau returned ne ud on ani way šè seir.
api jacob journeyed šè succoth, ù built him an é, api nirmā booths arthạm ani cattle: therefore bi name ak tad sthāna is mu-ù succoth.
ù jacob è šè shalem, a city ak shechem, yad is antar bi kalam sya canaan, when eṣa gin prabhṛti padanaram; ca pitched ani tent before eṣa city.
ù eṣa bought a parcel asya a field, where sa had spread asya tent, at bi hand asya eṣa children sya hamor, shechem's father, arthạm an hundred pieces ak money.
ù ayam erected ni an altar, u3 āhva ne eleloheisrael.
ù dinah bi daughter asya leah, lú she bare prati jacob, du bāhya prati paś eṣa daughters ak bi kur.
ca when shechem tad dumu sya hamor eṣa hivite, prince asya eṣa country, paś ani-munus, ayam took ani-munus, u3 lay ù ani-munus, api defiled ani-munus.
ù ani soul clave šè dinah bi daughter asya jacob, u3 ayam loved bi damsel, api spake kindly prati tad damsel.
u3 shechem spake abhimukham tasya father hamor, kathay, get me bi damsel šè wife.
ù jacob heard yad eṣa had defiled dinah asya daughter: now ani ibila bhū sahita ani cattle antar bi field: ù jacob held bi peace until they gál gin.
ca hamor sa father ak shechem du è šè jacob šè commune saha him.

ù sa dumu asya jacob gin bāhya asya bi field when they heard bi: tathā bi men bhū grieved, ù they bhū very wroth, because bi had wrought folly a israel ša lying saha jacob's daughter; yaḥ thing ought mā šè me done.
tathā hamor communed da bi-ne, inim, tad soul sya my ātmaja shechem longeth arthạm your daughter: i pray you give tasyāḥ him abhimukham wife.
u3 nirmā ye marriages da us, u3 give your daughters šè us, u3 take our daughters abhimukham you.
ù ye shall dwell saha us: u3 eṣa kalam shall vṛt before you; dwell u3 trade ye therein, api get you possessions therein.
ù shechem vac šè ani-munus father api abhimukham asyāḥ brethren, dā me find grace ša your eyes, ù what ye shall brū prati me i will give.
ask me never evam much dowry ù gift, ù i will give according as ye shall dug4 prati me: but give me bi damsel šè wife.
ca tad ātmaja ak jacob answered shechem ù hamor asya father deceitfully, api brū, because ani had defiled dinah bi-meš sister:
u3 they brū prati etān, we cannot do ne thing, prati give our sister šè prathama tad is uncircumcised; šè tad gál a reproach prati us:
but antar idam will we consent šè you: if ye will vṛt as we me, yad every male ak you vṛt circumcised;
then will we give our daughters šè you, tathā we will take your daughters šè us, ca we will dwell saha you, ù we will become eka saĝ.
but if ye will nu hearken prati us, prati me circumcised; then will we take our daughter, ù we will gál gone.
ù bi-meš words pleased hamor, u3 shechem hamor's dumu.
ca sa young puruṣa deferred nu abhimukham do bi thing, because eṣa had delight ša jacob's daughter: tathā bi me more honourable than sakala bi sadana sya bi father.
ù hamor tathā shechem tasya ibila è šè bi gate asya teṣām city, u3 communed da eṣa men ak eṣām city, brū,

these men are peaceable da us; therefore dā bi-ne dwell a tad kalam, u3 trade therein; kṛte bi pradeśa, behold, bi is large enough mu tān; dā us take bi-meš daughters šè us kṛte wives, u3 gá us give bi-ne our daughters.
only herein will tad men consent šè us mu šè dwell da us, prati bhū prathama saĝ, if every male among us as circumcised, as they are circumcised.
shall ul eṣām cattle tathā bi-meš substance ù every beast sya theirs me ours? only gá us consent abhimukham bi-ne, ca they will dwell ù us.
tathā šè hamor tathā šè shechem ani dumu hearkened gištug tad vraj bāhya asya bi gate sya bi city; u3 every male gál circumcised, šu tad è bahis asya tad gate ak bi city.

ca ne du abhimukham pass on bi tri ud, when they as sore, tad min ak bi suta ak jacob, simeon ù levi, dinah's brethren, took each nara ani sword, tathā du upari bi city boldly, tathā slew gištug bi males.
tathā they slew hamor u3 shechem bi dumu ù eṣa edge asya sa sword, ù took dinah bāhya ak shechem's sadana, ca è è.
eṣa ibila asya jacob āyā šu-ba bi slain, ù spoiled bi city, because they had defiled bi-meš sister.
they took teṣām sheep, ca bi-meš oxen, ù bi-meš asses, u3 yad yad gál antar bi city, ù yad yaḥ gál a tad field,
