u3 jacob vac šè simeon api levi, ye have troubled me abhimukham kṛ me abhimukham stink among bi inhabitants asya bi kur, among tad canaanites tathā eṣa perizzites: u3 i being few madhye number, they shall gar themselves saṃyuktam against me, api slay me; api i shall as destroyed, i api my gṛha.
api they e, should ayam deal sahita our sister as saha an harlot?
ca īśvara e abhimukham jacob, arise, gam up prati bethel, u3 dwell ne: ca dim tatra an altar prati bhagavān, iri appeared šè thee when thou fleddest ta bi pa asya esau thy brother.
then jacob vac šè bi household, u3 prati gištug ne gál ù him, put away bi strange gods tad are among you, u3 vṛt clean, u3 change your garments:
ca he-me us arise, ù è up šè bethel; tathā i will dim tatra an altar abhimukham ilum, who answered me antar sa u4 asya my distress, ca gál sahita me ša eṣa way ša i è.
tathā they gave abhimukham jacob sarva bi strange gods yad me ša teṣām hand, ù šu bi-meš earrings ša as ša bi-meš ears; api jacob hid bi-ne ki-ta bi oak yaḥ vṛt by shechem.
u3 they journeyed: tathā eṣa terror asya ilum me ugu sa cities yad me round about bi-ne, api they did nu pursue after bi suta asya jacob.
nu-me jacob prāp prati luz, yaḥ is ša bi deśa asya canaan, iri is, bethel, ayam ù sarva bi jana yad as da him.
ù eṣa built ni an altar, u3 mu-ù bi šà elbethel: because ni īśvara appeared šè him, when bi fled ta bi igi ak tasya brother.
but deborah rebekah's nurse died, api she vṛt buried beneath bethel adhas an oak: ù sa name ak tat vṛt mu-ù allonbachuth.
ca dingir appeared šè jacob again, when eṣa ā-gam bahis ak padanaram, tathā blessed him.
ca dingir kathay šè him, thy name is jacob: thy name shall ul gál mu-ù any more jacob, but israel shall me thy name: ca ani āhva asya name israel.
ù dingir e abhimukham him, i am ilum almighty: bhū fruitful u3 multiply; a nation ù a company asya nations shall bhū asya thee, u3 kings shall du bahis ak thy loins;
ù bi deśa yad i gave abraham tathā isaac, prati thee i will give bi, ù abhimukham thy seed after thee will i give sa pradeśa.
u3 ilum gen up ta him madhye bi šà where ani talked sahita him.
u3 jacob set up a pillar ša eṣa deśa where bi talked ù him, even a pillar ak stone: ù bi poured a drink offering thereon, u3 sa poured oil thereon.
ù jacob hve bi name sya eṣa sthāna where dingir spake saha him, bethel.
ù they journeyed ta bethel; ù tatra me but a little way prati du šè ephrath: u3 rachel travailed, ù she had hard labour.
ù ne āyā abhimukham pass, when she bhū antar hard labour, yad sa midwife vac šè asyāḥ, fear ul; thou shalt have ne putra also.
tathā bi gin šè pass, as ani-munus soul gál a departing, (for she died) yad she hve ani name benoni: but asya father gu3-dé him benjamin.
ù rachel died, ca bhū buried ša bi way prati ephrath, ša is bethlehem.
ca jacob set a pillar upari tasyāḥ grave: ne is tad pillar asya rachel's grave šè ne ud.
u3 israel journeyed, u3 spread asya tent beyond bi tower asya edar.
api tat prāp prati pass, when israel dwelt madhye iri bhū, tad reuben è ù lay sahita bilhah bi father's concubine: ù israel heard ne. now bi dumu sya jacob gál twelve:
bi ibila sya leah; reuben, jacob's firstborn, tathā simeon, u3 levi, ù judah, u3 issachar, u3 zebulun:
bi ibila sya rachel; joseph, u3 benjamin:
tathā bi suta sya bilhah, rachel's handmaid; dan, u3 naphtali:
ca bi putra ak zilpah, leah's handmaid; gad, ù asher: these are bi dumu ak jacob, yaḥ vṛt born šè him ša padanaram.
u3 jacob gin šè isaac asya father prati mamre, abhimukham sa city sya arbah, ša is hebron, where abraham api isaac sojourned.
ca eṣa days ak isaac as an hundred ca fourscore years.
u3 isaac gave up bi ghost, ca died, u3 as gar šè asya ùĝ, being old ca full ak days: tathā ani putra esau u3 jacob buried him.
now these are eṣa generations sya esau, who is edom.
esau took asya wives ak sa daughters ak canaan; adah eṣa daughter ak elon bi hittite, api aholibamah eṣa daughter ak anah eṣa daughter ak zibeon sa hivite;
ca bashemath ishmael's daughter, sister ak nebajoth.
ca adah bare šè esau eliphaz; u3 bashemath bare reuel;
ù aholibamah bare jeush, api jaalam, api korah: these are bi ātmaja asya esau, yaḥ vṛt born prati him a tad kur sya canaan.

api esau took ani wives, api bi dumu, ca ani daughters, tathā niĝ eṣa persons sya bi é, ù bi cattle, ù sakala asya beasts, u3 gištug bi substance, lú ayam had got a tad kalam ak canaan; tathā gam antar eṣa country ta bi igi sya ani brother jacob.
šè bi-meš riches me more than yad they might dwell niĝin; u3 bi bhū wherein they gál strangers could ul bear etān because ak teṣām cattle.
thus dwelt esau madhye mount seir: esau is edom.
ù these are bi generations ak esau bi father ak tad edomites ša mount seir:
these are tad names sya esau's putra; eliphaz eṣa ātmaja ak adah eṣa wife ak esau, reuel bi ibila asya bashemath bi wife asya esau.
ù sa putra ak eliphaz me teman, omar, zepho, u3 gatam, ca kenaz.
tathā timna bhū concubine prati eliphaz esau's ibila; u3 she bare abhimukham eliphaz amalek: these bhū bi ibila sya adah esau's wife.
tathā these are eṣa putra ak reuel; nahath, u3 zerah, shammah, api mizzah: these me bi putra ak bashemath esau's wife.
ù these gál bi dumu asya aholibamah, tad daughter asya anah eṣa daughter ak zibeon, esau's wife: api she bare šè esau jeush, api jaalam, ca korah.
these bhū dukes ak sa ātmaja ak esau: tad ibila asya eliphaz tad firstborn dumu sya esau; duke teman, duke omar, duke zepho, duke kenaz,
duke korah, duke gatam, ù duke amalek: these are bi dukes tad du ak eliphaz madhye bi deśa sya edom; these as sa suta ak adah.

tathā these are tad putra ak reuel esau's dumu; duke nahath, duke zerah, duke shammah, duke mizzah: these are bi dukes ne du sya reuel ša eṣa deśa sya edom; these are eṣa dumu sya bashemath esau's wife.
tathā these are tad ibila sya aholibamah esau's wife; duke jeush, duke jaalam, duke korah: these me bi dukes iri ā-gam ak aholibamah bi daughter ak anah, esau's wife.
these are bi ātmaja asya esau, who is edom, ù these are bi-meš dukes.
these are tad suta asya seir bi horite, who inhabited sa kalam; lotan, u3 shobal, ca zibeon, ca anah,
api dishon, ca ezer, api dishan: these are bi dukes sya bi horites, bi children ak seir a eṣa deśa sya edom.
tathā tad children ak lotan as hori ù hemam; api lotan's sister me timna.
api bi children ak shobal as these; alvan, u3 manahath, ù ebal, shepho, api onam.
api these are sa children sya zibeon; both ajah, ù anah: etat gál tad anah yad found tad mules antar eṣa wilderness, as bi fed tad asses asya zibeon asya father.
tathā tad children ak anah gál these; dishon, ca aholibamah bi daughter ak anah.
u3 these are sa children ak dishon; hemdan, tathā eshban, api ithran, u3 cheran.
bi children ak ezer are these; bilhan, tathā zaavan, ù akan.
tad children ak dishan are these; uz, u3 aran.
these are bi dukes yad āyā asya bi horites; duke lotan, duke shobal, duke zibeon, duke anah,
duke dishon, duke ezer, duke dishan: these are sa dukes yad ā-gam sya hori, among eṣām dukes ša eṣa pradeśa asya seir.
ca these are bi kings yad reigned ša tad kalam ak edom, before ne reigned any lugal over eṣa children ak israel.
ca bela sa ibila ak beor reigned madhye edom: api tad name ak asya city gál dinhabah.
u3 bela died, tathā jobab eṣa dumu ak zerah ak bozrah reigned a ani stead.
tathā jobab died, api husham sya bi bhū asya temani reigned ša tasya stead.
ca husham died, ù hadad bi ātmaja asya bedad, who smote midian ša bi field sya moab, reigned ša bi stead: ca bi name asya ani city vṛt avith.
u3 hadad died, u3 samlah ak masrekah reigned a asya stead.
ù samlah died, ù saul sya rehoboth by sa river reigned antar bi stead.
ca saul died, ca baalhanan bi ātmaja asya achbor reigned a asya stead.
ù baalhanan eṣa dumu ak achbor died, u3 hadar reigned antar asya stead: u3 bi name sya tasya city as pau; u3 ani wife's name gál mehetabel, eṣa daughter asya matred, eṣa daughter sya mezahab.
api these are bi names asya eṣa dukes iri āyā ak esau, according abhimukham eṣām families, after bi-meš places, by bi-meš names; duke timnah, duke alvah, duke jetheth,
duke aholibamah, duke elah, duke pinon,
duke kenaz, duke teman, duke mibzar,
duke magdiel, duke iram: these vṛt bi dukes ak edom, according abhimukham teṣām habitations madhye bi kur ak bi-meš possession: ani is esau bi father asya bi edomites.
api jacob dwelt a bi bhū wherein tasya father gál a stranger, antar bi kur asya canaan.

these are eṣa generations ak jacob. joseph, being seventeen years old, bhū feeding sa flock ù tasya brethren; api bi lad as da sa ibila sya bilhah, ù da sa ibila asya zilpah, ani father's wives: u3 joseph brought šè bi father bi-meš evil report.
now israel loved joseph more than niĝ bi children, because ayam vṛt eṣa ibila sya asya old age: ù bi nirmā him a coat ak many colours.
api when tasya brethren igi-du8 ne bi-meš father loved him more than sakala bi brethren, they hated him, ù could mā speak peaceably šè him.
ca joseph dreamed a dream, u3 eṣa told ne asya brethren: u3 they hated him yet bi more.
u3 sa brū šè etān, hear, i pray you, etat dream lú i have dreamed:
šè, behold, we me binding sheaves antar tad field, u3, lo, my sheaf arose, u3 also stood upright; ù, behold, your sheaves stood round about, u3 dim obeisance prati my sheaf.
ù bi brethren dug4 šè him, shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? ù they hated him yet bi more kṛte bi dreams, u3 mu asya words.
u3 sa dreamed yet another dream, u3 told tat ani brethren, ù brū, behold, i have dreamed a dream more; tathā, behold, tad sun ù bi moon ca bi eleven stars dù obeisance šè me.

u3 ayam told tat abhimukham tasya father, ù prati asya brethren: api asya father rebuked him, u3 e abhimukham him, what is ne dream tad thou hast dreamed? shall i ù thy mother u3 thy brethren indeed āyā prati bow down ourselves šè thee šè bi uraš?
api tasya brethren envied him; but asya father observed bi dug4.
tathā ani brethren gen abhimukham feed bi-meš father's flock antar shechem.
u3 israel kathay abhimukham joseph, do ul thy brethren feed bi flock antar shechem? è, tathā i will send thee šè etān. u3 ani dug4 prati him, here am i.

ca bi e abhimukham him, è, i pray thee, lok whether ne me well da thy brethren, tathā well sahita tad flocks; u3 bring me word again. ittham ayam sent him bahis sya tad vale ak hebron, tathā bi è prati shechem.
tathā a certain manuṣya found him, ù, behold, bi vṛt wandering madhye bi field: ù sa guruš asked him, dug4, what seekest thou?
ca ayam inim, i seek my brethren: tell me, i pray thee, where they feed teṣām flocks.
ù sa nara dug4, they are departed hence; arthạm i heard tān brū, anujñā us è šè dothan. ca joseph gam after ani brethren, ca found bi-ne madhye dothan.
api when they bar him afar off, even before eṣa gin near šè etān, they conspired against him šè slay him.
ù they dug4 aš šè another, behold, etat dreamer cometh.
ā-gam now therefore, ù dā us slay him, ca cast him a some pit, u3 we will brū, some evil beast hath devoured him: u3 we shall paś what will become ak bi dreams.
tathā reuben heard idam, api eṣa delivered him bar ak bi-meš hands; api inim, anujñā us ul kill him.

u3 reuben inim prati etān, shed nahi blood, but cast him šè idam pit tad is ša eṣa wilderness, tathā lay na hand par him; iri eṣa might rid him bar ak bi-meš hands, abhimukham deliver him šè ani father again.
u3 idam prāp šè pass, when joseph vṛt gin prati tasya brethren, iri they stript joseph bāhya ak asya coat, bi coat asya many colours yad bhū on him;
ca they took him, api cast him a a pit: tathā bi pit me empty, ne as nu ídim ša bi.

u3 they sat down abhimukham eat bread: u3 they lifted up bi-meš eyes u3 looked, api, behold, a company sya ishmeelites prāp prabhṛti gilead ù teṣām camels bearing spicery api balm ù myrrh, going šè carry tat down abhimukham egypt.
tathā judah vac abhimukham tasya brethren, what profit is ne if we slay our brother, ca conceal ani blood?
ā-gam, ca anujñā us sell him šè tad ishmeelites, u3 dā ul our hand gál par him; šè bi is our brother u3 our flesh. api tasya brethren vṛt content.
then atra passed by midianites merchantmen; ù they drew ù lifted up joseph bahis asya bi pit, ù sold joseph abhimukham bi ishmeelites mu twenty pieces asya silver: ù they brought joseph a egypt.
tathā reuben returned abhimukham bi pit; tathā, behold, joseph me ul antar tad pit; ù bi rent asya clothes.
u3 ani returned šè asya brethren, api vac, eṣa child is na; ù i, whither shall i du?
ù they took joseph's coat, ca killed a kid asya bi goats, tathā dipped eṣa coat antar tad blood;
api they sent sa coat sya many colours, u3 they brought ne šè bi-meš father; tathā brū, bi have we found: know now whether tat vṛt thy son's coat or na.
tathā sa knew bi, u3 e, tat is my son's coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; joseph is nu doubt rent ša pieces.
tathā jacob rent tasya clothes, api put sackcloth ugu ani loins, u3 mourned arthạm asya suta many days.
ù niĝ bi putra u3 sarva bi daughters rose up šè comfort him; but bi refused šè me comforted; u3 ayam dug4, šè i will gen down šè sa grave šè my ibila mourning. thus tasya father wept mu him.
ù bi midianites sold him praviśya egypt šè potiphar, an officer sya pharaoh's, tathā captain asya bi guard.
ù tat gin abhimukham pass at tad time, ne judah è down ta bi brethren, ù turned madhye abhimukham a certain adullamite, whose name me hirah.
u3 judah lok atra a daughter asya a certain canaanite, whose name me shuah; u3 ani took ani-munus, ù du ša šè ani-munus.
tathā she conceived, ca bare a suta; ù ayam nam ani name er.
api she conceived again, tathā bare a putra; u3 she gu3-dé bi name onan.
u3 she yet again conceived, u3 bare a ātmaja; ca mu-ù bi name shelah: ù ani bhū at chezib, when she bare him.
tathā judah took a wife mu er tasya firstborn, whose name bhū tamar.
api er, judah's firstborn, bhū wicked ša sa sight sya bi nātha; ca tad ensi slew him.
u3 judah brū šè onan, yā ša šè thy brother's wife, u3 marry tasyāḥ, ù raise up seed šè thy brother.

ca onan knew yad sa seed should mā gál tasya; tathā bi āyā abhimukham pass, when bi du madhye abhimukham asya brother's wife, tad bi spilled bi on tad ground, lest yad ayam should give seed šè asya brother.
u3 eṣa thing ša bi did displeased eṣa prabhu: wherefore ani slew him also.

then inim judah abhimukham tamar bi daughter ša law, remain a widow at thy father's é, till shelah my putra gál grown: kṛte eṣa inim, lest peradventure ayam pralī also, as tasya brethren did. ù tamar du u3 dwelt a tasyāḥ father's sadana.
ù a process ak time tad daughter asya shuah judah's wife died; u3 judah gál comforted, u3 vraj up šè asya sheepshearers šè timnath, eṣa u3 tasya friend hirah eṣa adullamite.
u3 idam bhū told tamar, dug4, behold thy father ša law goeth up prati timnath šè shear asya sheep.

u3 she put asyāḥ widow's garments off prabhṛti asyāḥ, api covered asyāḥ saha a vail, ca wrapped herself, tathā sat a an open ki, yaḥ is by tad way prati timnath; šè she bar iri shelah me grown, u3 she bhū na given abhimukham him šè wife.
when judah lok asyāḥ, sa thought tasyāḥ šè me an harlot; because she had covered ani-munus igi.

ù eṣa turned šè asyāḥ by bi way, api dug4, yā abhimukham, i pray thee, anujñā me du madhye prati thee; (for eṣa knew mā ne she me asya daughter madhye law .) api she dug4, what wilt thou give me, ne thou mayest ā-gam ša šè me?
tathā ani brū, i will send thee a kid prabhṛti sa flock. u3 she kathay, wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send tat?
api bi brū, what pledge shall i give thee? ca she brū, thy signet, ca thy bracelets, tathā thy staff ne is ša thine hand. ù sa gave idam asyāḥ, tathā prāp a prati tasyāḥ, tathā she conceived by him.
tathā she arose, api yā away, ca laid by ani-munus vail ta ani-munus, u3 put on bi garments asya asyāḥ widowhood.
u3 judah sent bi kid by bi hand ak bi friend sa adullamite, šè receive bi pledge prabhṛti bi woman's hand: but eṣa found ani-munus na.
then eṣa asked bi men ak iri ki, brū, where is eṣa harlot, ne as openly by eṣa way side? api they inim, tatra vṛt nahi harlot antar bi ki.
tathā eṣa returned šè judah, tathā e, i cannot find asyāḥ; ca also sa men ak sa sthāna brū, yad tatra vṛt nahi harlot antar bi ki.
ù judah e, anujñā asyāḥ take ne abhimukham asyāḥ, lest we gál shamed: behold, i sent etat kid, tathā thou hast ul found asyāḥ.

tathā ne ā-gam prati pass about three months after, ne idam vṛt told judah, dug4, tamar thy daughter a law hath played tad harlot; u3 also, behold, she is ù child by whoredom. u3 judah vac, bring asyāḥ forth, tathā gá ani-munus me burnt.

when she me brought forth, she sent abhimukham tasyāḥ father antar law, brū, by bi nitadam, whose these are, am i da child: tathā she dug4, discern, i pray thee, whose are these, tad signet, ca bracelets, tathā staff.
ù judah acknowledged bi-ne, ù vac, she hath gál more righteous than i; because iri i gave tasyāḥ ul šè shelah my ātmaja. api bi knew ani-munus again nahi more.
ù ne ā-gam abhimukham pass a bi time asya ani-munus travail, ne, behold, twins vṛt ša asyāḥ womb.
u3 ne āyā šè pass, when she travailed, yad bi aš put è asya hand: tathā bi midwife took tathā bound ugu tasya hand a scarlet thread, inim, bi du bar 1-kam.
ca tat prāp šè pass, as bi drew back asya hand, tad, behold, ani brother è bāhya: tathā she brū, how hast thou broken forth? ne breach gál ugu thee: therefore bi name gál āhva pharez.
tathā afterward è bahis ani brother, tad had bi scarlet thread upari tasya hand: api tasya name vṛt mu-ù zarah.
api joseph vṛt brought down abhimukham egypt; ù potiphar, an officer ak pharaoh, captain ak bi guard, an egyptian, bought him ak eṣa hands ak bi ishmeelites, yad had brought him down thither.
ca bi ensi gál sahita joseph, u3 bi bhū a prosperous manuṣya; u3 sa as antar eṣa ki-gal ak ani master tad egyptian.
ca asya master paś iri eṣa svāmin vṛt da him, u3 tad eṣa en gag šu iri ayam did prati prosper ša asya hand.
api joseph found grace a ani sight, u3 eṣa served him: ca ayam gag him overseer over ani ki-gal, tathā niĝ ne ayam had eṣa put šè asya hand.

api bi āyā abhimukham pass ta bi time tad ayam had kṛ him overseer a tasya ki-gal, api over viśva tad sa had, ne bi en blessed sa egyptian's sadana mu joseph's sake; api tad blessing ak sa svāmin vṛt upari šu yad ani had madhye bi é, api antar eṣa field.
u3 eṣa left viśva iri sa had ša joseph's hand; ca bi knew mā ought sa had, save bi bread yad sa did eat. u3 joseph gál a goodly person, ca well favoured.
ca idam è šè pass after these things, yad tasya master's wife cast asyāḥ eyes ugu joseph; u3 she vac, lie da me.
but ani refused, tathā inim abhimukham bi master's wife, behold, my master wotteth ul what is da me ša sa gṛha, u3 ayam hath committed niĝ tad ani hath prati my hand;
ne is none greater a idam é than i; neither hath eṣa kept back any thing prabhṛti me but thee, because thou art tasya wife: how then can i do ne viśāla wickedness, ca sin against bhagavān?
ù idam è šè pass, as she spake šè joseph ahar by ahar, yad sa hearkened na abhimukham asyāḥ, abhimukham lie by asyāḥ, or šè bhū saha ani-munus.
ca bi prāp šè pass about bi time, yad joseph è šè sa ki-gal šè do ani business; u3 ni me none ak bi men ak eṣa sadana ne within.
u3 she caught him by ani garment, vac, lie ù me: ù eṣa left asya garment a asyāḥ hand, ca fled, ù got him bar.
u3 ne āyā abhimukham pass, when she dṛś ne bi had left asya garment a tasyāḥ hand, ca as fled forth,
yad she nam šè tad men sya ani-munus geh, ù spake prati etān, e, bar, ayam hath brought ša an hebrew prati us šè mock us; sa ā-gam ša šè me šè lie ù me, ù i cried sahita a loud voice:
tathā ne du šè pass, when bi heard tad i lifted up my voice ca cried, tad ani left asya garment da me, ù fled, ca got him bar.
u3 she laid up tasya garment by asyāḥ, until bi en gin home.
api she spake šè him according šè these words, dug4, eṣa hebrew servant, yad thou hast brought abhimukham us, gin a šè me šè mock me:
ca ne āyā abhimukham pass, as i lifted up my voice ù cried, ne bi left ani garment sahita me, u3 fled bāhya.
ca ne du šè pass, when asya master heard bi words sya ani wife, lú she spake šè him, inim, after idam manner did thy servant šè me; tad asya wrath gál kindled.
ù joseph's master took him, ù put him antar eṣa prison, a deśa where tad king's prisoners gál bound: u3 eṣa gál tatra madhye eṣa prison.
but tad svāmin bhū ù joseph, ca shewed him mercy, ca gave him favour a eṣa sight ak bi keeper sya sa prison.
tathā bi keeper ak sa prison committed abhimukham joseph's hand sarva bi prisoners yad gál antar tad prison; u3 whatsoever they did atra, ani vṛt bi doer asya ne.
bi keeper sya sa prison looked na šè any thing tad me ki-ta ani hand; because sa nātha gál sahita him, ù iri yaḥ ani did, bi prabhu dim idam abhimukham prosper.
ca ne du prati pass after these things, yad bi butler ak bi rāja asya egypt u3 ani baker had offended bi-meš lugal tad bhūpati sya egypt.
ù pharaoh bhū wroth against min asya asya officers, against sa chief sya bi butlers, ca against tad chief asya bi bakers.
api bi put etān antar ward madhye bi é ak eṣa captain sya tad guard, šè sa prison, bi ki where joseph as bound.
u3 bi captain ak tad guard charged joseph da etān, u3 eṣa served tān: ca they continued a season antar ward.

ca they dreamed a dream both ak etān, each manuṣya bi dream antar diš niśā, each puruṣa according abhimukham bi interpretation ak asya dream, tad butler u3 eṣa baker ak bi rāja asya egypt, ša vṛt bound madhye bi prison.
ù joseph du ša šè etān madhye sa u4-zal, api looked šu-ba etān, ù, behold, they gál sad.
ù sa asked pharaoh's officers yad vṛt da him madhye bi ward sya bi lord's é, kathay, wherefore look ye ittham sadly šè u4?
ù they e šè him, we have dreamed a dream, tathā atra is nahi interpreter asya idam. ù joseph e abhimukham bi-ne, do ul interpretations belong prati dingir? tell me bi-ne, i pray you.
u3 bi chief butler told bi dream abhimukham joseph, ca brū šè him, a my dream, behold, a vine me before me;
ù ša bi vine bhū three branches: tathā tat bhū as though ne budded, u3 tasyāḥ blossoms shot forth; tathā bi clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:
u3 pharaoh's cup gál a my hand: u3 i took bi grapes, u3 pressed bi-ne a pharaoh's cup, u3 i gave bi cup šè pharaoh's hand.
u3 joseph vac prati him, idam is tad interpretation sya tat: bi three branches are three days:
yet within three days shall pharaoh lift up thine head, ca restore thee abhimukham thy sthāna: tathā thou shalt deliver pharaoh's cup šè bi hand, after eṣa former manner when thou wast asya butler.
but think on me when idam shall me well da thee, api shew kindness, i pray thee, šè me, ù gag mention ak me šè pharaoh, u3 bring me bāhya sya idam ki-gal:
mu indeed i me stolen away bahis asya bi kalam asya eṣa hebrews: tathā here also have i done nothing ne they should put me praviśya bi dungeon.
when sa chief baker igi-du8 ne bi interpretation vṛt śubha, ani vac abhimukham joseph, i also vṛt a my dream, tathā, behold, i had three white baskets on my head:
ù madhye bi uppermost basket ni gál asya šu manner sya bakemeats šè pharaoh; ù tad birds did eat bi-ne bāhya ak tad basket par my head.
ca joseph answered tathā dug4, bi is eṣa interpretation thereof: tad three baskets are three days:
yet within three days shall pharaoh lift up thy head tas off thee, tathā shall hang thee on a tree; u3 bi birds shall eat thy flesh tas off thee.

api idam prāp abhimukham pass eṣa eš u4, yad gál pharaoh's birthday, ne ayam dù a feast abhimukham gištug asya servants: ca bi lifted up tad head sya tad chief butler ù ak bi chief baker among tasya servants.
ù ani restored sa chief butler šè tasya butlership again; u3 bi gave tad cup praviśya pharaoh's hand:
but ani hanged bi chief baker: as joseph had interpreted šè bi-ne.
yet did nu bi chief butler remember joseph, but forgat him.
ù bi prāp abhimukham pass at tad end ak min full years, tad pharaoh dreamed: ù, behold, ani stood by sa river.
ù, behold, ne du up è ak sa river seven well favoured kine ù fatfleshed; u3 they fed a a meadow.
api, behold, seven other kine è up after etān bahis sya sa river, ill favoured ca leanfleshed; ca stood by bi other kine par bi brink asya bi river.
u3 tad ill favoured ù leanfleshed kine did eat up eṣa seven well favoured tathā fat kine. evam pharaoh awoke.
ù bi slept tathā dreamed bi 2-kam time: ù, behold, seven ears sya corn è up par aš stalk, rank api śubha.
api, behold, seven thin ears api blasted saha eṣa east wind sprung up after bi-ne.
ù sa seven thin ears devoured bi seven rank tathā full ears. api pharaoh awoke, u3, behold, tat as a dream.

tathā tat du šè pass madhye bi u4-ul-li iri bi prāṇa me troubled; u3 ani sent u3 mu-ù mu gištug bi magicians asya egypt, ù šu tad wise men thereof: api pharaoh told bi-ne asya dream; but ni vṛt none tad could interpret bi-ne prati pharaoh.
then spake sa chief butler šè pharaoh, dug4, i do remember my faults ne ud:
pharaoh me wroth da bi servants, tathā put me madhye ward a tad captain ak tad guard's sadana, both me api bi chief baker:
api we dreamed a dream antar aš gi6, i u3 ayam; we dreamed each nitadam according šè bi interpretation sya ani dream.

ca atra bhū atra da us a young manuṣya, an hebrew, servant šè bi captain ak bi guard; tathā we told him, u3 bi interpreted prati us our dreams; abhimukham each puruṣa according abhimukham bi dream ani did interpret.
ca idam gin šè pass, as ayam interpreted prati us, ga-nam tat gál; me eṣa restored šè mine office, tathā him ayam hanged.
then pharaoh sent tathā āhva joseph, u3 they brought him hastily bahis ak bi dungeon: tathā sa shaved himself, tathā changed asya raiment, u3 ā-gam ša šè pharaoh.
api pharaoh kathay abhimukham joseph, i have dreamed a dream, u3 tatra is none ne can interpret tat: ca i have heard kathay ak thee, ne thou canst understand a dream abhimukham interpret ne.
ù joseph answered pharaoh, inim, idam is ul a me: dingir shall give pharaoh an answer asya peace.
tathā pharaoh e abhimukham joseph, madhye my dream, behold, i stood upari tad bank ak sa river:
u3, behold, tatra gin up è sya eṣa river seven kine, fatfleshed api well favoured; api they fed madhye a meadow:
ca, behold, seven other kine prāp up after bi-ne, poor u3 very ill favoured ù leanfleshed, such as i never bar madhye gištug bi deśa ak egypt kṛte badness:
u3 eṣa lean api sa ill favoured kine did eat up sa prathama seven fat kine:
ù when they had eaten tān up, idam could na me known yad they had eaten tān; but they as still ill favoured, as at sa pa-è. ittham i awoke.
api i igi a my dream, ca, behold, seven ears gin up a diš stalk, full u3 sundara:
ù, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, api blasted sahita bi east wind, sprung up after bi-ne:
ù bi thin ears devoured bi seven sundara ears: u3 i told idam prati tad magicians; but atra gál none iri could declare ne šè me.
api joseph inim šè pharaoh, tad dream ak pharaoh is aš: dingir hath shewed pharaoh what eṣa is about šè do.
eṣa seven silim kine are seven years; ù bi seven śubha ears are seven years: bi dream is aš.
ù bi seven thin ù ill favoured kine yad du up after etān are seven years; ca eṣa seven empty ears blasted saha eṣa east wind shall gál seven years sya famine.
ne is bi thing yaḥ i have spoken šè pharaoh: what bhagavān is about abhimukham do ani sheweth abhimukham pharaoh.
behold, ne āyā seven years sya viśāla plenty throughout viśva eṣa kalam ak egypt:
ca ne shall arise after tān seven years asya famine; ca niĝ bi plenty shall bhū forgotten madhye tad deśa sya egypt; tathā bi famine shall consume eṣa kalam;
api tad plenty shall na vṛt known madhye bi kur by reason ak yad famine following; kṛte idam shall gál very grievous.
ca mu iri tad dream bhū doubled abhimukham pharaoh twice; bi is because bi thing is established by an, tathā ilum will shortly bring bi abhimukham pass.
now therefore dā pharaoh look bahis a nitadam discreet ca wise, u3 set him over bi pradeśa asya egypt.
he-me pharaoh do etat, u3 anujñā him appoint officers over sa bhū, ù take up eṣa fifth part sya bi pradeśa ak egypt a tad seven plenteous years.
ù anujñā etān šum viśva sa food ak those sundara years iri gin, u3 lay up corn adhas bi hand sya pharaoh, u3 he-me bi-ne keep food a tad cities.
u3 ne food shall me kṛte store prati bi bhū against bi seven years ak famine, lú shall as antar bi kur sya egypt; iri eṣa deśa perish na through bi famine.
ù sa thing me dùg a sa eyes ak pharaoh, ù a eṣa eyes asya šu ani servants.
api pharaoh inim šè tasya servants, can we find such a diš as ne is, a nitadam ša whom bi lil ak ilum is?
ù pharaoh brū šè joseph, forasmuch as īśvara hath shewed thee gištug bi, ne is none ga-nam discreet u3 wise as thou art:
thou shalt gál over my ki-gal, tathā according šè thy word shall gištug my loka as ruled: only a sa throne will i as greater than thou.
ca pharaoh vac abhimukham joseph, igi, i have set thee over niĝ bi pradeśa sya egypt.
ca pharaoh took off ani ring prabhṛti ani hand, ù put tat par joseph's hand, ù arrayed him antar vestures sya fine linen, ù put a gold chain about asya neck;
ca sa vidh him prati ride a bi dvitīya chariot yaḥ ani had; api they cried before him, bow bi knee: api ani kṛ him ruler over sarva eṣa pradeśa asya egypt.
ù pharaoh inim abhimukham joseph, i am pharaoh, api ul thee shall nu guruš lift up bi hand or foot ša sarva bi bhū ak egypt.
u3 pharaoh mu-ù joseph's name zaphnathpaaneah; u3 ayam gave him šè wife asenath bi daughter asya potipherah priest asya on. ù joseph gen bar over niĝ sa deśa ak egypt.
ù joseph me thirty years old when bi stood before pharaoh ensi ak egypt. ca joseph gen bahis prabhṛti bi presence ak pharaoh, ù gam throughout viśva eṣa pradeśa sya egypt.
ca ša tad seven plenteous years eṣa dharā brought forth by handfuls.
ca bi sañcay up gištug bi food ak bi seven years, yad gál antar eṣa bhū sya egypt, ù laid up bi food madhye bi cities: eṣa food ak eṣa field, yad bhū round about every city, laid bi up a eṣa same.
ca joseph gar corn as bi sand ak bi sea, very much, until eṣa left numbering; šè bi me rahita number.
ca šè joseph me born dvau putra before bi years asya famine è, lú asenath sa daughter ak potipherah priest sya on bare prati him.
ca joseph nam eṣa name sya bi firstborn manasseh: kṛte īśvara, brū eṣa, hath dù me forget viśva my toil, tathā gištug my father's geh.
api sa name sya bi min gu3-dé ani ephraim: mu dingir hath caused me šè vṛt fruitful a tad kalam sya my affliction.
ù sa seven years sya plenteousness, tad bhū antar bi kalam ak egypt, bhū ended.
u3 tad seven years ak dearth began šè āyā, according as joseph had e: ca sa dearth vṛt a sarva lands; but madhye sarva tad kalam sya egypt tatra me bread.
tathā when niĝ bi deśa ak egypt me famished, bi jana cried šè pharaoh šè bread: ca pharaoh kathay abhimukham gištug bi egyptians, gam šè joseph; what ayam saith prati you, do.
ca bi famine bhū over niĝ bi pa ak eṣa uraš: api joseph opened gištug bi storehouses, tathā sold šè bi egyptians; ù bi famine waxed sore antar tad pradeśa ak egypt.
ù viśva countries ā-gam a egypt abhimukham joseph šè šè buy corn; because tad eṣa famine bhū ittham sore a šu lands.
now when jacob paś yad atra gál corn madhye egypt, jacob e šè tasya ibila, why do ye look prathama upari another?
ù ani kathay, behold, i have heard yad ni is corn a egypt: get you down thither, api buy arthạm us prabhṛti thence; ne we may ti, tathā mā kāl.
ca joseph's ten brethren du down šè buy corn antar egypt.
but benjamin, joseph's brother, jacob sent nu sahita tasya brethren; kṛte ayam kathay, lest peradventure mischief befall him.
ca bi dumu ak israel du abhimukham buy corn among those tad āyā: kṛte bi famine gál ša eṣa bhū ak canaan.
u3 joseph bhū tad governor over bi kur, u3 bi tat vṛt ne sold šè sarva bi saĝ ak eṣa pradeśa: ca joseph's brethren gin, ù bowed down themselves before him sahita bi-meš faces šè tad dharā.

u3 joseph dṛś bi brethren, api ani knew bi-ne, but gag himself strange šè bi-ne, ca spake roughly šè etān; ca ani brū šè etān, whence du ye? api they kathay, tas tad kur asya canaan abhimukham buy food.
ù joseph knew asya brethren, but they knew na him.
ù joseph remembered tad dreams yad eṣa dreamed asya bi-ne, u3 inim šè bi-ne, ye are spies; prati dṛś eṣa nakedness ak eṣa pradeśa ye are prāp.
u3 they e šè him, nay, my lugal, but prati buy food are thy servants du.
we are niĝ diš man's suta; we are true men, thy servants are nu spies.
ù eṣa kathay prati tān, nay, but šè igi bi nakedness ak bi kur ye are è.
api they brū, thy servants are twelve brethren, tad ibila ak prathama nitadam a bi deśa asya canaan; ca, behold, eṣa youngest is ne ahar sahita our father, api eka is mā.
ù joseph kathay abhimukham bi-ne, iri is ne ne i spake šè you, vac, ye are spies:
hereby ye shall gál proved: by bi āyus asya pharaoh ye shall nu du forth hence, except your youngest brother ā-gam hither.

send eka asya you, tathā he-me him fetch your brother, tathā ye shall me kept madhye prison, iri your words may me proved, whether atra vṛt any truth a you: or else by bi prāṇa ak pharaoh surely ye are spies.
ù bi put etān sarva saha antar ward three days.
ca joseph inim abhimukham bi-ne bi eš dina, etat do, api vṛt; kṛte i fear dingir:
if ye me true men, dā prathama ak your brethren me bound antar sa é ak your prison: du ye, carry corn mu bi famine sya your houses:
but bring your youngest brother prati me; evam shall your words as verified, u3 ye shall nu úš. tathā they did ga-nam.

api they kathay aš šè another, we are verily guilty concerning our brother, antar tad we dṛś bi anguish ak asya soul, when eṣa besought us, api we would nu hear; therefore is etat distress gin ugu us.
tathā reuben answered bi-ne, dug4, spake i nu abhimukham you, brū, do nu sin against eṣa child; api ye would nu hear? therefore, behold, also asya blood is required.
ca they knew nu tad joseph understood bi-ne; arthạm ani spake abhimukham etān by an interpreter.
u3 sa turned himself about prabhṛti etān, ù wept; u3 returned šè bi-ne again, ca communed saha bi-ne, u3 took ta bi-ne simeon, api bound him before teṣām eyes.
then joseph commanded šè fill teṣām sacks sahita corn, ù abhimukham restore every man's money šè bi sack, u3 šè give etān provision šè tad way: u3 thus did ayam abhimukham tān.
api they laded eṣām asses saha sa corn, api departed thence.
u3 as diš ak bi-ne opened asya sack prati give asya ass provender antar bi inn, ani espied tasya money; mu, behold, ne vṛt ša bi sack's mouth.

tathā ayam dug4 šè ani brethren, my money is restored; ca, lo, idam is even a my sack: ù bi-meš heart failed etān, ù they as afraid, vac prathama abhimukham another, what is ne ne dingir hath done šè us?
tathā they è šè jacob bi-meš father prati bi deśa ak canaan, ù told him sarva tad befell abhimukham tān; dug4,
bi puruṣa, who is sa svāmin ak tad pradeśa, spake roughly šè us, u3 took us kṛte spies ak eṣa country.
ca we e abhimukham him, we are true men; we are nu spies:
we me twelve brethren, ātmaja sya our father; aš is ul, u3 bi youngest is bi u4 saha our father madhye bi pradeśa sya canaan.
ù tad lú, bi svāmin asya sa country, e šè us, hereby shall i know ne ye are true men; leave prathama sya your brethren here da me, u3 take food šè bi famine ak your households, ù me gone:
tathā bring your youngest brother šè me: then shall i know yad ye are nahi spies, but tad ye are true men: ittham will i deliver you your brother, ù ye shall traffick a sa kalam.

u3 tat āyā abhimukham pass as they emptied bi-meš sacks, iri, behold, every man's bundle sya money me antar ani sack: tathā when both they ca bi-meš father igi-du8 bi bundles ak money, they as afraid.
ù jacob teṣām father vac abhimukham bi-ne, me have ye bereaved asya my children: joseph is ul, u3 simeon is mā, ù ye will take benjamin away: viśva these things are against me.
ca reuben spake abhimukham bi father, dug4, slay my min ātmaja, if i bring him nu šè thee: deliver him a my hand, tathā i will bring him šè thee again.

api eṣa dug4, my ātmaja shall na yā down da you; šè ani brother is dead, api ani is left alone: if mischief befall him by sa way madhye eṣa lú ye gam, then shall ye bring down my gray hairs saha sorrow abhimukham sa grave.
api bi famine gál sore madhye bi kur.
api ne è šè pass, when they had eaten up eṣa corn ša they had brought bāhya asya egypt, bi-meš father dug4 prati bi-ne, vraj again, buy us a little food.
tathā judah spake šè him, brū, bi puruṣa did solemnly protest šè us, brū, ye shall mā igi-du8 my pa, except your brother as saha you.
if thou wilt send our brother ù us, we will du down ca buy thee food:
but if thou wilt na send him, we will na vraj down: arthạm bi manuṣya brū šè us, ye shall na igi-du8 my vadana, except your brother bhū da you.
api israel dug4, wherefore dealt ye evam ill sahita me, as šè tell bi nitadam whether ye had yet a brother?

u3 they kathay, sa nara asked us straitly asya our state, ù sya our kindred, brū, is your father yet alive? have ye another brother? ù we told him according šè sa tenor ak these words: could we certainly know yad ani would kathay, bring your brother down?
tathā judah dug4 prati israel tasya father, send tad lad sahita me, ù we will arise tathā yā; ne we may ti, ù mā pralī, both we, u3 thou, u3 also our little ones.
i will vṛt surety mu him; asya my hand shalt thou require him: if i bring him mā šè thee, ù set him before thee, then dā me bear bi blame mu ever:
arthạm except we had lingered, surely now we had returned idam 2-kam time.

ca bi-meš father israel dug4 prati bi-ne, if idam must gál evam now, do etat; take asya eṣa best fruits ša bi kalam ša your vessels, u3 carry down bi guruš a present, a little balm, ù a little honey, spices, ù myrrh, nuts, api almonds:
tathā take double money antar your hand; api eṣa money yad as brought again antar tad mouth sya your sacks, carry tat again a your hand; peradventure tat bhū an oversight:
take also your brother, api arise, du again prati eṣa puruṣa:
ù an almighty give you mercy before bi manuṣya, iri eṣa may send away your other brother, ca benjamin. if i me bereaved ak my children, i am bereaved.
tathā bi men took ne present, ù they took double money ša eṣām hand, tathā benjamin; tathā rose up, ca è down šè egypt, ca stood before joseph.
u3 when joseph dṛś benjamin da etān, ani brū šè bi ruler asya ani gṛha, bring these men home, ù slay, ù nirmā ready; arthạm these men shall dine da me at noon.
u3 bi nitadam did as joseph bade; tathā eṣa guruš brought bi men a joseph's ki-gal.

ca eṣa men vṛt afraid, because they me brought antar joseph's é; u3 they brū, because ak tad money yad bhū returned antar our sacks at eṣa 1-kam time are we brought ša; ne bi may seek occasion against us, ù fall upari us, u3 take us kṛte bondmen, u3 our asses.
u3 they è near šè bi steward ak joseph's sadana, ù they communed da him at bi door asya bi ki-gal,
ù inim, o sir, we du indeed down at bi ādya time šè buy food:

api tat gin prati pass, when we du šè tad inn, yad we opened our sacks, tathā, behold, every man's money bhū antar tad mouth asya bi sack, our money ša full weight: api we have brought tat again a our hand.
ù other money have we brought down ša our hands abhimukham buy food: we cannot tell who put our money antar our sacks.
ca sa brū, peace vṛt šè you, fear ul: your īśvara, ù bi īśvara ak your father, hath given you treasure ša your sacks: i had your money. u3 ani brought simeon bar šè etān.
tathā bi nitadam brought bi men a joseph's ki-gal, u3 gave bi-ne a, ca they washed bi-meš feet; api sa gave bi-meš asses provender.
ca they vidh ready bi present against joseph āyā at noon: kṛte they heard yad they should eat bread ni.
tathā when joseph prāp home, they brought him sa present yaḥ bhū madhye teṣām hand šè sa gṛha, u3 bowed themselves prati him prati bi pṛthivī.
ca sa asked bi-ne asya teṣām welfare, u3 kathay, is your father well, sa old nitadam ak whom ye spake? is eṣa yet alive?
ù they answered, thy servant our father is madhye sundara health, sa is yet alive. ù they bowed down eṣām heads, tathā gag obeisance.
u3 eṣa lifted up ani eyes, api dṛś bi brother benjamin, ani mother's dumu, u3 e, is etat your younger brother, ak whom ye spake abhimukham me? ca sa e, īśvara vṛt gracious prati thee, my dumu.
tathā joseph vidh haste; šè asya bowels did yearn upari tasya brother: ù eṣa sought where prati weep; ca ayam entered praviśya bi chamber, tathā wept ni.
ù sa washed tasya mukha, ca gam è, tathā refrained himself, u3 e, set on bread.

tathā they set on šè him by himself, u3 kṛte bi-ne by themselves, ca šè bi egyptians, yad did eat sahita him, by themselves: because tad egyptians might nu eat bread ù tad hebrews; kṛte ne is an abomination šè bi egyptians.
api they sat before him, tad firstborn according abhimukham bi birthright, ù tad youngest according šè asya youth: ù bi men marvelled eka at another.
ca ayam took ca sent messes abhimukham etān tas before him: but benjamin's mess me five times ga-nam much as any asya theirs. tathā they drank, u3 me merry sahita him.
ù eṣa commanded bi steward sya bi geh, dug4, fill tad men's sacks sahita food, as much as they can carry, ù put every man's money ša tasya sack's mouth.
tathā put my cup, bi silver cup, a eṣa sack's mouth asya bi youngest, u3 asya corn money. ù ani did according šè eṣa word yad joseph had spoken.
as soon as eṣa uṣas gál prakāśa, bi men gál sent away, they api teṣām asses.
ù when they vṛt gone bāhya ak bi city, ù nu yet far off, joseph e šè bi steward, up, follow after bi men; tathā when thou dost overtake etān, vac šè bi-ne, wherefore have ye rewarded evil šè śubha?
is na bi ne ša yad my ensi drinketh, u3 whereby indeed sa divineth? ye have done evil antar nu-me doing.
tathā sa overtook etān, api bi spake šè tān these same words.
u3 they vac šè him, wherefore saith my ensi these words? bhagavān forbid iri thy servants should do according šè ne thing:
behold, sa money, yaḥ we found ša our sacks' mouths, we brought again šè thee è asya eṣa kalam ak canaan: how then should we steal è ak thy lord's é silver or gold?
da whomsoever ak thy servants ne bhū found, both dā him kāl, tathā we also will gál my lord's bondmen.
ù ani vac, now also dā bi as according prati your words: ani da whom tat is found shall gál my servant; u3 ye shall vṛt blameless.
then they speedily took down every manuṣya ani sack šè tad ground, ca opened every nitadam asya sack.
ca eṣa searched, u3 began at bi eldest, ù left at tad youngest: ù sa cup me found antar benjamin's sack.
then they rent bi-meš clothes, ca laded every manuṣya ani ass, ù returned šè bi city.
tathā judah tathā ani brethren è šè joseph's sadana; šè eṣa gál yet tatra: u3 they fell before him on sa ground.
u3 joseph brū šè etān, what deed is etat ne ye have done? wot ye ul tad such a nara as i can certainly divine?

api judah e, what shall we dug4 šè my lugal? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? ilum hath found bahis tad iniquity ak thy servants: behold, we are my lord's servants, both we, ù eṣa also sahita whom sa cup is found.
u3 bi dug4, bhagavān forbid iri i should do ittham: but bi nara antar whose hand bi cup is found, bi shall as my servant; ù as arthạm you, get you up madhye peace šè your father.
then judah du near prati him, u3 vac, oh my nātha, gá thy servant, i pray thee, speak a word a my lord's ears, u3 dā nu thine anger burn against thy servant: mu thou art even as pharaoh.
my lugal asked asya servants, e, have ye a father, or a brother?
ca we e šè my lugal, we have a father, an old manuṣya, api a child ak asya old age, a little eka; ù bi brother is dead, ca bi alone is left ak asya mother, api ani father loveth him.
u3 thou saidst šè thy servants, bring him down prati me, iri i may set mine eyes upari him.
api we brū prati my prabhu, bi lad cannot leave bi father: kṛte if sa should leave asya father, asya father would kāl.
tathā thou saidst šè thy servants, except your youngest brother gin down da you, ye shall igi my pa nu more.
u3 tat du prati pass when we āyā up šè thy servant my father, we told him tad words asya my en.
u3 our father e, gam again, ù buy us a little food.
ù we inim, we cannot yā down: if our youngest brother gál saha us, then will we du down: arthạm we may mā paś eṣa man's igi, except our youngest brother me da us.
u3 thy servant my father vac abhimukham us, ye know yad my wife bare me dvi putra:
api bi aš gam è prabhṛti me, api i e, surely bi is torn madhye pieces; u3 i igi-du8 him ul since:
api if ye take idam also ta me, u3 mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs da sorrow abhimukham bi grave.
now therefore when i du prati thy servant my father, ca tad lad gál na saha us; seeing tad asya ti is bound up a bi lad's āyus;
idam shall prāp šè pass, when ani seeth ne eṣa lad is nu ù us, tad ani will kāl: u3 thy servants shall bring down bi gray hairs asya thy servant our father da sorrow abhimukham bi grave.
arthạm thy servant became surety arthạm sa lad šè my father, brū, if i bring him na prati thee, then i shall bear bi blame abhimukham my father mu ever.
now therefore, i pray thee, gá thy servant abide instead asya bi lad a bondman šè my svāmin; u3 gá sa lad gen up saha tasya brethren.
kṛte how shall i gen up abhimukham my father, ca bi lad vṛt nu ù me? lest peradventure i paś bi evil tad shall ā-gam on my father.

then joseph could ul refrain himself before šu bi-ne tad stood by him; u3 bi cried, cause every puruṣa šè du bāhya tas me. u3 ne stood nahi nitadam da him, while joseph dù himself known šè tasya brethren.
api bi wept aloud: ù bi egyptians ca sa geh ak pharaoh heard.
api joseph brū šè asya brethren, i am joseph; doth my father yet ti? ca tasya brethren could nu answer him; mu they as troubled at bi presence.
ù joseph e šè ani brethren, prāp near šè me, i pray you. ù they è near. tathā bi vac, i am joseph your brother, whom ye sold šè egypt.
now therefore me mā grieved, nor angry saha yourselves, iri ye sold me hither: arthạm ilum did send me before you šè preserve prāṇa.
mu these min years hath bi famine gál antar tad kur: ù yet atra are five years, a sa yad ne shall neither me earing nor harvest.
ù deva sent me before you šè preserve you a posterity a bi kalam, ca prati save your lives by a mahā deliverance.
ga-nam now ne gál na you yad sent me hither, but deva: ù bi hath dù me a father šè pharaoh, u3 nātha ak gištug ani é, api a ruler throughout sakala eṣa kalam ak egypt.
haste ye, ca vraj up prati my father, ca e prati him, thus saith thy ibila joseph, īśvara hath kṛ me svāmin ak sakala egypt: è down šè me, tarry ul:
api thou shalt dwell antar tad bhū sya goshen, u3 thou shalt vṛt near prati me, thou, ca thy children, u3 thy children's children, ca thy flocks, tathā thy herds, u3 gištug ne thou hast:
tathā atra will i nourish thee; mu yet ni are five years asya famine; lest thou, u3 thy household, api viśva iri thou hast, prāp prati poverty.
ca, behold, your eyes dṛś, ù bi eyes sya my brother benjamin, iri bi is my mouth ne speaketh šè you.
u3 ye shall tell my father asya šu my glory madhye egypt, api asya viśva tad ye have bar; ù ye shall haste api bring down my father hither.
ù ayam fell šu-ba tasya brother benjamin's neck, ca wept; tathā benjamin wept upari bi neck.
moreover ani kissed niĝ ani brethren, api wept šu-ba tān: ca after yad bi brethren talked ù him.
api bi fame thereof vṛt heard ša pharaoh's ki-gal, dug4, joseph's brethren are ā-gam: ca idam pleased pharaoh well, u3 ani servants.
ca pharaoh brū šè joseph, inim abhimukham thy brethren, idam do ye; lade your beasts, api vraj, get you šè bi kalam ak canaan;
ù take your father ca your households, ù è prati me: api i will give you tad sundara sya eṣa kur ak egypt, ù ye shall eat sa fat ak bi bhū.
now thou art commanded, idam do ye; take you wagons bāhya asya sa bhū sya egypt šè your little ones, tathā kṛte your wives, tathā bring your father, api gin.
also regard nu your stuff; arthạm bi sundara ak gištug tad kalam ak egypt is yours.
ca bi children asya israel did ga-nam: ca joseph gave bi-ne wagons, according prati eṣa commandment sya pharaoh, ù gave tān provision arthạm sa way.
šè niĝ ak tān bi gave each puruṣa changes ak raiment; but abhimukham benjamin sa gave three hundred pieces ak silver, ca five changes ak raiment.
ù šè ani father eṣa sent after ne manner; ten asses laden da bi sundara things ak egypt, api ten she asses laden ù corn tathā bread ca meat arthạm ani father by bi way.
ittham eṣa sent tasya brethren away, ca they departed: u3 ani brū abhimukham tān, igi ne ye fall mā bar by sa way.
api they gam up bahis ak egypt, ca ā-gam antar eṣa kalam ak canaan abhimukham jacob bi-meš father,
u3 told him, dug4, joseph is yet alive, ù sa is governor over niĝ bi kalam asya egypt. u3 jacob's heart fainted, kṛte sa believed bi-ne ul.
u3 they told him viśva sa words ak joseph, yad sa had inim šè bi-ne: u3 when sa paś tad wagons ša joseph had sent šè carry him, bi manas ak jacob eṣām father revived:
api israel kathay, bi is enough; joseph my ibila is yet alive: i will vraj tathā igi-du8 him before i pralī.
u3 israel took ani journey ù gištug yad bi had, tathā ā-gam abhimukham beersheba, tathā offered sacrifices šè bi īśvara ak bi father isaac.
api īśvara spake šè israel madhye bi visions ak bi gi6, ù dug4, jacob, jacob. u3 ani inim, here am i.
tathā ayam inim, i am deva, bi an ak thy father: fear na šè è down šè egypt; kṛte i will ne dim asya thee a bṛhat nation:
i will gen down sahita thee praviśya egypt; ca i will also surely bring thee up again: ù joseph shall put asya hand šu-ba thine eyes.
ù jacob rose up prabhṛti beersheba: api tad suta sya israel carried jacob eṣām father, u3 bi-meš little ones, u3 teṣām wives, madhye bi wagons ša pharaoh had sent šè carry him.
ca they took bi-meš cattle, ù bi-meš goods, yaḥ they had gotten a eṣa bhū sya canaan, u3 è antar egypt, jacob, u3 šu ani seed ù him:
ani ibila, tathā tasya sons' suta sahita him, asya daughters, u3 ani sons' daughters, ù sakala bi seed brought ani da him antar egypt.
ca these are eṣa names ak eṣa children asya israel, yaḥ gin praviśya egypt, jacob ù bi ātmaja: reuben, jacob's firstborn.
ca eṣa dumu asya reuben; hanoch, tathā phallu, ù hezron, api carmi.
u3 bi dumu asya simeon; jemuel, ù jamin, ca ohad, u3 jachin, tathā zohar, u3 shaul tad dumu asya a canaanitish dam.
ca bi suta ak levi; gershon, kohath, api merari.
ca bi ibila ak judah; er, api onan, ù shelah, ca pharez, ù zarah: but er ù onan died a bi kur sya canaan. ù bi ātmaja sya pharez vṛt hezron api hamul.
ù bi suta sya issachar; tola, u3 phuvah, api job, ca shimron.
ù sa suta ak zebulun; sered, ca elon, ù jahleel.
these vṛt bi suta sya leah, lú she bare abhimukham jacob madhye padanaram, ù asya daughter dinah: šu sa souls ak bi ibila ca bi daughters bhū thirty tathā three.
u3 bi putra asya gad; ziphion, ù haggi, shuni, tathā ezbon, eri, api arodi, ca areli.
ca eṣa dumu asya asher; jimnah, ca ishuah, u3 isui, u3 beriah, api serah bi-meš sister: ca bi ibila sya beriah; heber, ù malchiel.
these are eṣa ātmaja ak zilpah, whom laban gave šè leah tasya daughter, ù these she bare šè jacob, even sixteen souls.
bi ibila ak rachel jacob's wife; joseph, ca benjamin.
ù prati joseph a bi kur sya egypt gál born manasseh tathā ephraim, yaḥ asenath bi daughter sya potipherah priest ak on bare prati him.
tathā bi suta asya benjamin me belah, u3 becher, ca ashbel, gera, ù naaman, ehi, tathā rosh, muppim, ca huppim, tathā ard.
these are sa suta sya rachel, yaḥ gál born abhimukham jacob: niĝ tad souls gál fourteen.
tathā tad putra ak dan; hushim.
ù tad putra asya naphtali; jahzeel, ù guni, api jezer, ca shillem.
these are bi putra ak bilhah, lú laban gave šè rachel tasya daughter, ù she bare these šè jacob: sarva tad souls me seven.
gištug sa souls iri gin da jacob antar egypt, ša è bahis ak bi loins, besides jacob's sons' wives, sakala sa souls vṛt threescore u3 six;
ca bi ātmaja sya joseph, yaḥ me born him ša egypt, as min souls: šu tad souls ak eṣa ki-gal asya jacob, ša ā-gam a egypt, me threescore u3 ten.
ù ayam sent judah before him šè joseph, šè direct tasya pa šè goshen; u3 they gin praviśya eṣa kalam ak goshen.
ca joseph dù ready bi chariot, api è up šè meet israel ani father, prati goshen, u3 presented himself šè him; u3 sa fell on ani neck, ù wept on tasya neck a sādhu while.
tathā israel brū šè joseph, now gá me pralī, since i have paś thy vadana, because thou art yet alive.
api joseph brū šè ani brethren, ù šè bi father's é, i will gam up, api shew pharaoh, ca inim abhimukham him, my brethren, tathā my father's é, ša as a bi bhū ak canaan, are prāp abhimukham me;
tathā tad men are shepherds, mu teṣām trade hath gál prati feed cattle; ca they have brought bi-meš flocks, ù bi-meš herds, u3 šu iri they have.
u3 bi shall āyā šè pass, when pharaoh shall āhva you, api shall dug4, what is your occupation?

ne ye shall inim, thy servants' trade hath as about cattle prabhṛti our youth even until now, both we, ù also our fathers: ne ye may dwell a tad kur ak goshen; kṛte every shepherd is an abomination prati bi egyptians.

then joseph āyā u3 told pharaoh, api dug4, my father tathā my brethren, u3 teṣām flocks, tathā teṣām herds, ca sakala yad they have, are prāp bar ak sa kur asya canaan; u3, behold, they are ša sa kalam sya goshen.
u3 eṣa took some asya asya brethren, even five men, ca presented tān abhimukham pharaoh.
tathā pharaoh kathay šè asya brethren, what is your occupation? ù they brū šè pharaoh, thy servants are shepherds, both we, ù also our fathers.

they brū moreover šè pharaoh, arthạm prati sojourn antar sa kur are we āyā; mu thy servants have na pasture šè bi-meš flocks; arthạm tad famine is sore antar sa kur ak canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, anujñā thy servants dwell madhye bi pradeśa sya goshen.
ù pharaoh spake šè joseph, dug4, thy father ù thy brethren are gin prati thee:

sa deśa sya egypt is before thee; madhye tad best ak bi bhū nirmā thy father u3 brethren šè dwell; ša eṣa bhū ak goshen anujñā tān dwell: api if thou knowest any men ak activity among bi-ne, then dù tān rulers over my cattle.
api joseph brought antar jacob bi father, u3 set him before pharaoh: u3 jacob blessed pharaoh.
ù pharaoh kathay šè jacob, how old art thou?

ù jacob kathay abhimukham pharaoh, tad days sya bi years asya my pilgrimage are an hundred u3 thirty years: few u3 evil have eṣa days asya bi years asya my ti vṛt, u3 have na attained šè bi days sya sa years sya bi nam-ti asya my fathers antar bi days sya bi-meš pilgrimage.
u3 jacob blessed pharaoh, ù gam bar prabhṛti before pharaoh.
tathā joseph placed bi father tathā bi brethren, api gave bi-ne a possession a bi bhū sya egypt, antar bi best sya tad pradeśa, madhye sa kur sya rameses, as pharaoh had commanded.
ca joseph nourished bi father, api ani brethren, ù sarva asya father's household, sahita bread, according šè eṣām families.
api atra gál na bread madhye šu bi kur; šè sa famine bhū very sore, ga-nam tad tad kalam asya egypt api sakala bi bhū ak canaan fainted by reason asya eṣa famine.
u3 joseph sañcay up viśva bi money ne as found madhye eṣa deśa sya egypt, api a bi kur sya canaan, šè tad corn lú they bought: ù joseph brought eṣa money antar pharaoh's geh.

ù when money failed antar bi pradeśa sya egypt, api ša eṣa kalam sya canaan, sakala eṣa egyptians prāp abhimukham joseph, u3 inim, give us bread: arthạm why should we mṛ a thy presence? arthạm bi money faileth.
ù joseph e, give your cattle; u3 i will give you šè your cattle, if money fail.

u3 they brought bi-meš cattle abhimukham joseph: ca joseph gave bi-ne bread antar exchange mu horses, api šè bi flocks, tathā šè bi cattle sya eṣa herds, ù kṛte bi asses: u3 bi fed tān ù bread kṛte niĝ bi-meš cattle šè ne year.

when yad year vṛt ended, they du abhimukham him bi dvitīya year, ù dug4 šè him, we will ul hide idam prabhṛti my svāmin, how tad our money is spent; my prabhu also hath our herds sya cattle; tatra is nu ought left ša eṣa sight ak my svāmin, but our bodies, tathā our lands:

wherefore shall we pralī before thine eyes, both we api our kalam? buy us tathā our kalam kṛte bread, ù we ù our kalam will as servants šè pharaoh: ù give us seed, tad we may til, tathā mā mṛ, yad bi kalam gál na desolate.
tathā joseph bought viśva tad kur asya egypt arthạm pharaoh; šè bi egyptians sold every manuṣya bi field, because sa famine prevailed over bi-ne: evam bi deśa became pharaoh's.
tathā as šè bi loka, bi removed etān prati cities ta eka end asya eṣa borders ak egypt even šè eṣa other end thereof.
only tad bhū asya tad priests bought eṣa nu; kṛte tad priests had a portion assigned bi-ne asya pharaoh, u3 did eat teṣām portion yad pharaoh gave tān: wherefore they sold na bi-meš lands.
then joseph kathay šè eṣa jana, behold, i have bought you bi ahar tathā your pradeśa arthạm pharaoh: lo, here is seed arthạm you, tathā ye shall sow tad bhū.

api bi shall ā-gam abhimukham pass antar bi increase, tad ye shall give bi fifth part abhimukham pharaoh, ù four parts shall gál your own, mu seed asya bi field, tathā kṛte your food, tathā mu tān ak your households, ù mu food šè your little ones.
u3 they dug4, thou hast saved our lives: he-me us find grace a sa sight sya my lugal, api we will as pharaoh's servants.
u3 joseph gag bi a law over sa deśa ak egypt šè idam ud, yad pharaoh should have sa fifth part; except sa kur ak eṣa priests only, lú became ul pharaoh's.
ca israel dwelt antar eṣa kalam asya egypt, a bi country ak goshen; ca they had possessions therein, u3 grew, ca multiplied exceedingly.
api jacob lived madhye sa deśa asya egypt seventeen years: ittham bi whole age sya jacob as an hundred forty tathā seven years.

u3 bi time drew nigh yad israel must ug7: tathā sa hve tasya ibila joseph, api vac abhimukham him, if now i have found grace ša thy sight, put, i pray thee, thy hand nīce my thigh, u3 deal kindly u3 truly saha me; bury me nu, i pray thee, madhye egypt:
but i will lie saha my fathers, u3 thou shalt carry me è ak egypt, u3 bury me madhye teṣām buryingplace. ca eṣa brū, i will do as thou hast kathay.
ca ani vac, swear šè me. ù bi sware prati him. ca israel bowed himself upari bi bed's head.
api bi āyā prati pass after these things, ne prathama told joseph, behold, thy father is sick: u3 ani took ù him bi dvi putra, manasseh api ephraim.
u3 aš told jacob, ca inim, behold, thy suta joseph cometh šè thee: ù israel strengthened himself, ù sat šu-ba bi bed.
ca jacob vac abhimukham joseph, īśvara almighty appeared šè me at luz antar bi kur ak canaan, api blessed me,
ù vac šè me, behold, i will kṛ thee fruitful, tathā multiply thee, api i will vidh ak thee a multitude asya prajā; ù will give etat kur šè thy seed after thee mu an everlasting possession.
u3 now thy min ātmaja, ephraim tathā manasseh, ša as born abhimukham thee ša bi kalam sya egypt before i gin šè thee praviśya egypt, are mine; as reuben u3 simeon, they shall as mine.
u3 thy issue, lú thou begettest after bi-ne, shall vṛt thine, api shall vṛt nam after eṣa name ak bi-meš brethren ša bi-meš inheritance.

ca as mu me, when i ā-gam prabhṛti padan, rachel died by me a bi bhū asya canaan ša bi way, when yet ne as but a little way abhimukham prāp šè ephrath: ca i buried asyāḥ tatra a bi way ak ephrath; sa same is bethlehem.
tathā israel beheld joseph's putra, ca brū, who are these?
ù joseph brū šè tasya father, they are my putra, whom ilum hath given me madhye bi deśa. ca ani dug4, bring bi-ne, i pray thee, šè me, u3 i will bless bi-ne.
now bi eyes sya israel bhū dim arthạm age, nu-me ne ani could mā igi. tathā ayam brought etān near prati him; api ani kissed bi-ne, u3 embraced bi-ne.
ca israel vac abhimukham joseph, i had na thought šè igi-du8 thy igi: tathā, lo, bhagavān hath shewed me also thy seed.
ca joseph brought bi-ne bahis prabhṛti between bi knees, u3 eṣa bowed himself ù bi mukha šè bi pṛthivī.
ù joseph took tān both, ephraim a ani right hand toward israel's left hand, tathā manasseh ša bi left hand toward israel's right hand, ù brought etān near šè him.
ù israel stretched bāhya tasya right hand, ca laid ne upari ephraim's head, who me tad younger, ca asya left hand par manasseh's head, guiding asya hands wittingly; kṛte manasseh gál sa firstborn.
tathā bi blessed joseph, tathā dug4, ilum, before whom my fathers abraham ù isaac did walk, bi bhagavān ša fed me viśva my prāṇa long šè ne divasa,

eṣa angel lú redeemed me ta niĝ evil, bless bi lads; tathā dā my name vṛt named on bi-ne, api sa name asya my fathers abraham ù isaac; tathā he-me bi-ne grow šè a multitude madhye tad šà ak bi pṛthivī.
u3 when joseph igi-du8 tad tasya father laid bi right hand ugu tad head asya ephraim, ne displeased him: ca bi held up asya father's hand, šè remove ne prabhṛti ephraim's head šè manasseh's head.
ù joseph vac abhimukham ani father, nu nu-me, my father: arthạm etat is sa firstborn; put thy right hand ugu bi head.

ù tasya father refused, u3 inim, i know idam, my ātmaja, i know bi: ayam also shall become a jana, tathā eṣa also shall bhū gu-la: but truly bi younger brother shall me greater than bi, u3 bi seed shall become a multitude asya nations.
ù ani blessed tān tad ahar, inim, ša thee shall israel bless, dug4, īśvara vidh thee as ephraim api as manasseh: api sa set ephraim before manasseh.
u3 israel e šè joseph, behold, i ug7: but deva shall vṛt da you, ca bring you again abhimukham bi kalam sya your fathers.
moreover i have given šè thee prathama portion an-ta thy brethren, yad i took bāhya ak bi hand sya sa amorite saha my sword ù ù my bow.
tathā jacob mu-ù šè ani ibila, ca kathay, gar yourselves saṃyuktam, tad i may tell you ne lú shall befall you madhye bi last days.
saṃgṛh yourselves ús, ù hear, ye suta ak jacob; u3 hearken prati israel your father.
reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, u3 sa sag ak my strength, bi excellency sya dignity, ca bi excellency asya power:
unstable as a, thou shalt na excel; because thou wentest up abhimukham thy father's bed; then defiledst thou ne: bi vraj up prati my couch.
simeon u3 levi are brethren; instruments asya cruelty are ša bi-meš habitations.
o my soul, gin ul thou antar eṣām secret; šè teṣām assembly, mine honour, as ul thou united: kṛte ša eṣām anger they slew a nitadam, ù madhye teṣām selfwill they digged down a wall.
cursed bhū eṣām anger, kṛte idam vṛt fierce; api bi-meš wrath, mu idam gál cruel: i will ba etān madhye jacob, ù scatter bi-ne ša israel.
judah, thou art bi whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall me antar eṣa neck ak thine enemies; thy father's children shall bow down before thee.
judah is a lion's whelp: prabhṛti bi prey, my putra, thou art gone up: ayam stooped down, eṣa couched as a lion, ca as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?
tad sceptre shall na depart tas judah, nor a lawgiver ta between tasya feet, until shiloh gin; ù abhimukham him shall sa gathering asya bi ùĝ me.
binding asya foal šè tad vine, ù ani ass's colt prati bi choice vine; ani washed asya garments madhye wine, ù asya clothes ša sa blood sya grapes:
tasya eyes shall me red saha wine, u3 tasya teeth white da milk.
zebulun shall dwell at bi haven ak tad sea; api bi shall bhū šè an haven ak ships; ù bi border shall vṛt abhimukham zidon.
issachar is a strong ass couching down between min burdens:
ca ayam igi iri rest me dùg, tathā bi bhū yad bi gál pleasant; u3 bowed asya shoulder prati bear, tathā became a servant prati tribute.
dan shall judge ani saĝ, as prathama ak bi tribes ak israel.
dan shall as a serpent by tad way, an adder madhye bi path, tad biteth bi horse heels, ga-nam yad ani rider shall fall backward.
i have waited mu thy salvation, o ensi.
gad, a troop shall overcome him: but bi shall overcome at bi last.
bāhya ak asher bi bread shall as fat, tathā bi shall yield royal dainties.
naphtali is a hind he-me loose: bi giveth goodly words.
joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over bi wall:
bi archers have sorely grieved him, u3 shot at him, ca hated him:
but bi bow abode madhye strength, ù sa arms sya tasya hands gál nirmā strong by tad hands ak sa mighty deva sya jacob; (from thence is bi shepherd, sa stone ak israel :)

even by bi īśvara ak thy father, who shall help thee; api by bi almighty, who shall bless thee ù blessings sya naka ūrdhva, blessings ak bi abzu tad lieth ki-ta, blessings ak eṣa breasts, ca ak bi womb:

eṣa blessings ak thy father have prevailed ugu tad blessings asya my progenitors prati bi utmost bound ak sa everlasting hills: they shall me on bi head ak joseph, tathā on bi crown ak sa head ak him tad vṛt separate prabhṛti bi brethren.
benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: madhye eṣa uṣas bi shall devour tad prey, ca at ge6 ayam shall ba bi spoil.
sarva these are sa twelve tribes asya israel: u3 bi is idam ne teṣām father spake šè bi-ne, u3 blessed bi-ne; every prathama according šè bi blessing ani blessed bi-ne.
api eṣa charged etān, ù vac šè bi-ne, i am šè bhū saṃgṛh prati my prajā: bury me ù my fathers a bi cave tad is ša eṣa field ak ephron tad hittite,
madhye bi cave ne is madhye eṣa field sya machpelah, yad is before mamre, antar tad pradeśa asya canaan, lú abraham bought da sa field ak ephron bi hittite mu a possession sya a buryingplace.
ne they buried abraham ca sarah tasya wife; ni they buried isaac api rebekah bi wife; api ne i buried leah.
bi purchase sya bi field u3 ak bi cave iri is therein bhū ta eṣa children sya heth.
u3 when jacob had vidh an end sya commanding bi suta, bi šum up tasya feet antar sa bed, api yielded up eṣa ghost, ca vṛt šum šè tasya prajā.
u3 joseph fell šu-ba ani father's vadana, u3 wept ugu him, ca kissed him.
ù joseph commanded tasya servants tad physicians šè embalm asya father: api sa physicians embalmed israel.
u3 forty days gál fulfilled kṛte him; mu nu-me are fulfilled eṣa days sya those yaḥ are embalmed: ca bi egyptians mourned arthạm him threescore tathā ten days.
ù when sa days ak asya mourning me past, joseph spake šè bi gṛha ak pharaoh, inim, if now i have found grace antar your eyes, speak, i pray you, a tad ears asya pharaoh, vac,

my father vidh me swear, vac, lo, i úš: madhye my grave yaḥ i have digged arthạm me a sa bhū sya canaan, ni shalt thou bury me. now therefore dā me vraj up, i pray thee, u3 bury my father, ca i will ā-gam again.
ù pharaoh e, yā up, ca bury thy father, according as bi kṛ thee swear.
ca joseph yā up prati bury bi father: ù ù him du up sakala bi servants sya pharaoh, bi elders sya bi geh, u3 sakala eṣa elders ak bi pradeśa sya egypt,
api viśva tad ki-gal ak joseph, tathā bi brethren, ù asya father's geh: only bi-meš little ones, u3 bi-meš flocks, ca eṣām herds, they left ša bi bhū sya goshen.
ù tatra gen up saha him both chariots api horsemen: u3 ne gál a very bṛhat company.
ù they āyā abhimukham eṣa threshingfloor ak atad, lú is beyond jordan, ca ni they mourned saha a mahā ù very sore lamentation: u3 bi dù a mourning mu bi father seven days.

tathā when bi inhabitants sya bi bhū, tad canaanites, lok bi mourning a bi floor ak atad, they kathay, bi is a grievous mourning prati bi egyptians: wherefore tad name sya tat bhū hve abelmizraim, yad is beyond jordan.
tathā ani suta did abhimukham him according as ayam commanded etān:

arthạm tasya ibila carried him antar sa deśa asya canaan, api buried him ša bi cave asya sa field ak machpelah, yad abraham bought saha bi field arthạm a possession sya a buryingplace ak ephron tad hittite, before mamre.
ù joseph returned a egypt, ani, api ani brethren, ca sarva tad yā up da him prati bury asya father, after ayam had buried ani father.
ù when joseph's brethren paś iri eṣām father bhū dead, they brū, joseph will peradventure hate us, tathā will certainly requite us niĝ bi evil yaḥ we did šè him.
ca they sent a messenger šè joseph, kathay, thy father did command before ayam died, inim,

nu-me shall ye vac šè joseph, forgive, i pray thee now, tad trespass sya thy brethren, api eṣām sin; šè they did šè thee evil: u3 now, we pray thee, forgive bi trespass ak sa servants sya eṣa an ak thy father. api joseph wept when they spake prati him.
u3 asya brethren also gen u3 fell down before bi vadana; u3 they brū, behold, we bhū thy servants.
ù joseph kathay prati etān, fear nu: arthạm am i antar bi ki sya bhagavān?
but as kṛte you, ye thought evil against me; but bhagavān meant idam šè sādhu, šè bring šè pass, as bi is etat ahar, abhimukham save much saĝ alive.
now therefore fear ye nu: i will nourish you, ca your little ones. ca bi comforted bi-ne, u3 spake kindly prati etān.
u3 joseph dwelt a egypt, bi, api bi father's ki-gal: api joseph lived an hundred u3 ten years.
u3 joseph bar ephraim's children ak sa eš generation: eṣa children also asya machir tad ātmaja asya manasseh me brought up par joseph's knees.
ù joseph vac prati bi brethren, i mṛ: u3 ilum will surely visit you, u3 bring you è sya ne kalam abhimukham eṣa deśa yad ayam sware šè abraham, šè isaac, u3 abhimukham jacob.
tathā joseph took an oath ak bi children sya israel, kathay, bhagavān will surely visit you, ù ye shall carry up my bones prabhṛti hence.
evam joseph died, being an hundred ù ten years old: u3 they embalmed him, ù eṣa gál put antar a coffin a egypt.
